articles.title: Measuring Data Diversity with Embeddings: A Taxonomy and Benchmark for Diversity Measures
articles.abstract: Diversity is a critical property of text corpora, with direct implications for training data curation, test set design, and model generalization. However, its measurement remains fragmented and poorly understood. Existing embedding-based diversity measures vary widely in how they are computed and can yield substantially different diversity scores on the same data, yet no systematic comparison of their empirical behaviour exists. We make two contributions toward addressing this gap. First, we present a taxonomy of 21 embedding-based diversity measures, organizing them into four families based on their underlying computations. Second, we introduce EmbDivBench, a benchmark that evaluates these measures along three conceptually distinct components (variety, balance and disparity) on both simulated and natural text data. Although Mean Pairwise Distance is the most commonly used measure, our experiments show that it is outperformed by several alternatives on the three diversity components, with Graph Entropy being the best choice overall. Lastly, we distil these findings into practical recommendations for diversity measure selection.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main). Code and data: https://github.com/nlpsoc/EmbDivBench
articles.titleCn: 使用嵌入测量数据多样性：多样性度量的分类和基准
articles.abstractCn: 多样性是文本语料库的一个关键属性，直接影响训练数据管理、测试集设计和模型泛化能力。然而，多样性的测量方法仍然分散且理解不足。现有的基于嵌入的多样性度量方法在计算方式上差异巨大，对相同数据可能产生显著不同的多样性分数，但至今仍缺乏对其经验行为的系统性比较。我们针对这一空白做出了两项贡献。首先，我们提出了一个包含21种基于嵌入的多样性度量的分类体系，根据其底层计算方法将其组织为四个家族。其次，我们引入了EmbDivBench基准，该基准在模拟和自然文本数据上，沿三个概念上不同的维度（多样性、平衡性和差异性）评估这些度量方法。尽管平均成对距离是最常用的度量方法，但我们的实验表明，它在三个多样性维度上均被多种替代方法超越，其中图熵是总体表现最佳的选择。最后，我们将这些发现提炼为多样性度量方法选择的实用建议。

articles.title: The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.
articles.titleCn: 一像素推理：一个真实关系足以误导大语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 一句话能否通过针对单个连接证据与结论的隐式前提来操纵代理的信念？在本文中，我们引入了一元关系攻击（ORA），这是一种针对这种推理关系的新型认知攻击。ORA定位一个关键隐式前提，并使用一个以单一源头为依据的句子进行一元关系干预，该句子使该前提失效，并引导代理走向错误的信念。在生物医学推理和漏洞检测的十八个模型上，最佳十次攻击的平均反转正确答案的比率分别为54.9%（专有模型）和80.0%（开放权重模型）。攻击还可以在没有受害者反馈的情况下进行转移，配对对照实验支持了目标定位和前提失效的作用。此外，成功的句子可以通过源头支持检查并逃避识别，而在我们的平衡压力测试中，多代理辩论将团队错误率从50.0%提高到59.5%。这些发现将隐式前提确立为操纵代理信念的认知攻击面。

articles.title: The Missing Compliance Class: LLM Graders That Collapse Jailbreak Success, and a Free Check
articles.abstract: Jailbreak papers report an attack success rate, the share of responses that deliver the harmful request, and read it as a property of the target model. We hold the target model, the prompts and the responses fixed and change only the grader. Three dense graders of 8B and 9B parameters, from three model families, move compliant responses to the neighbouring class, evasion, instead of scattering them across classes. One of them assigns the compliance label zero times in 900 responses. This class collapse also appears on new harmful requests, on a target model from a third family, and in a held-out 7B grader from a fourth family. Per-class label counts expose it at no cost and without human labels. The collapse decides how the rate behaves under a change of grader. On two corpora of 900 responses and eight graders, the compliance rate differs by a factor of 22 to 25, while the non-refusal rate differs by 18 to 23 percentage points. Without the three collapsing graders, compliance differs by a factor of 1.7 to 2.8 on all four corpora, and non-refusal still differs by 10 to 22 points. These results do not change when every grader is called once. We propose a reporting minimum that keeps the compliance rate and adds its per-class label counts and the named grader. Beside it goes the non-refusal rate, whose disagreement across graders is additive.

articles.titleCn: 缺失的合规类别：导致越狱成功的LLM评分器崩溃，以及免费检查
articles.abstractCn: 越狱论文报告了一种攻击成功率，即提供有害请求的响应比例，并将其视为目标模型的一种属性。我们保持目标模型、提示和响应固定，仅改变评分器。三个模型家族的8B和9B参数的三个密集评分器将合规响应移至相邻类别（规避），而不是分散到各个类别。其中有一个评分器在900个响应中一次也没有分配合规标签。这种类别坍塌现象也出现在新的有害请求上，出现在来自第三个家族的目标模型，以及来自第四个家族的保留的7B评分器上。按类别的标签计数无需成本且无需人工标签就能揭示这一点。这种坍塌决定了在评分器变化时成功率的行为。在两个包含900个响应和八个评分器的语料库上，合规率相差22到25倍，而非拒绝率相差18到23个百分点。如果没有这三个坍塌评分器，在所有四个语料库上合规率相差1.7到2.8倍，而非拒绝率仍然相差10到22个百分点。当每个评分器只调用一次时，这些结果不会改变。我们提出一个报告最低标准，它保持合规率，并添加其按类别的标签计数和命名评分器。旁边是拒绝率，其跨评分器的分歧是可加的。

articles.title: Bellman Language Models: Solving the Recurring Decisions of LLM Agents
articles.abstract: A general observation in agentic workflows, especially bounded ones, is that the decision space of the LLM, when we separate a decision from generation, starts approaching saturation: the agent meets the same states again and again, and after enough conversations it stops meeting new ones. LLMs generally don't treat these decisions as an optimization problem and instead re-derive them from their context/prompt on every turn. We show that treating decision making within reasonable bounds as an optimization problem, solving it once, and reusing the solved decisions can often make an agent faster, cheaper and more reliable. Our approach, which we call Discretize, Then Decide, starts from data such as the workflow's own logs or, when none exists, runs of the LLM agent itself. It reads each conversation into discrete states and estimates the probability of each outcome and the cost of each move, until no new states appear and the probabilities stop changing. It then solves the resulting Markov decision process. The solution runs as a controller around the model, sending moves whose content is fixed in the state, such as a tool call or a templated reply, and any state it hasn't seen is sent back to the LLM. We call an LLM run this way a Bellman language model (BLM), after Richard Bellman's equation for the best move in each state. On $τ^2$-bench telecom, the controller with no model solves 79% of tasks. As a BLM, Qwen3.8-27B, an open model, goes from 29% to 96% with 93% fewer model calls. For Claude Opus 5.5, which solves 96% of tasks on its own, running it as a BLM cuts model calls and cost per task by about 98% and lets it solve 2 more tasks. On InventoryBench, the solved policy with no model beats every published method. Where the hard part is writing content rather than choosing moves, such as resolving SymPy issues, few decisions can be solved in advance, and a BLM helps little.
articles.titleCn: 贝尔曼语言模型：解决大语言模型代理的循环决策问题
articles.abstractCn: 在自主工作流中，尤其是在有界工作流中，一个普遍的观察是：当我们分离决策与生成时，大语言模型（LLM）的决策空间开始接近饱和。代理反复遇到相同的状态，经过足够的对话后便不再遇到新状态。LLM通常不将这些决策视为优化问题，而是在每轮中从其上下文/提示中重新推导。我们证明，在合理范围内将决策视为优化问题，一次性解决并重用已解决的决策，通常可以使代理更快、更经济、更可靠。我们的方法，称为“离散化，然后决策”（Discretize, Then Decide），从工作流自身的日志等数据开始，或者在不存在日志时运行LLM代理的运行。它将每场对话读入离散状态，并估计每个结果的概率以及每个动作的成本，直到不再出现新状态且概率停止变化。然后它解决由此产生的马尔可夫决策过程。该解决方案作为模型周围的控制器运行，发送内容在状态中固定的动作，例如工具调用或模板化回复，而对于它未见过的新状态则发送回LLM。我们将这种方式运行的LLM称为贝尔曼语言模型（BLM），以纪念理查德·贝尔曼提出的每个状态下最佳动作的方程。在$τ^2$-基准电信测试中，无模型的控制器解决了79%的任务。作为BLM，开源模型Qwen3.8-27B从29%提升至96%，模型调用次数减少了93%。对于自行解决96%任务的Claude Opus 5.5，将其作为BLM运行可减少约98%的模型调用次数和每任务成本，并使其能解决2项更多任务。在InventoryBench上，无模型的解决策略击败了所有已发表的方法。在写内容比选择动作更困难的情况下，例如解决SymPy问题，很少能预先解决决策，BLM的帮助也有限。

articles.title: Dual Task Vector Merging: Leveraging Emotion and ASR Knowledge for Low-Resource Alzheimer's Disease Detection
articles.abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) detection from speech benefits from both paralinguistic and linguistic cues, yet model training is frequently constrained by limited data. Fine-tuning a large pretrained speech encoder can easily overfit, while a frozen probe leaves the encoder's task-relevant knowledge underutilized. Therefore, we propose Dual Task Vector Merging, a parameter-efficient method that adapts a frozen wav2vec 2.0 backbone using task knowledge learned outside the AD task. Specifically, we inject two task vectors, derived as weight deltas from emotion- and ASR-fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 models, into each transformer layer. During AD training, only layer-wise merging coefficients and a linear classification head are optimized, updating less than 0.1% of the parameters required for full fine-tuning. Speaker-independent experiments on ADReSS and ADReSSo show that dual merging improves over frozen probes, LoRA, and full fine-tuning, in the main binary settings, and gives the best results when combined with LoRA. Evaluation on PROCESS further shows that our advantages transfer to three-class HC/MCI/dementia classification when paired with LoRA. Experiments under reduced training data (20%, 40%, and 80%) confirm reliable gains in low-resource settings.
articles.titleCn: 双任务向量合并：利用情感和语音识别知识进行低资源阿尔茨海默病检测
articles.abstractCn: 从语音中检测阿尔茨海默病（AD）需要利用语音的副语言和语言线索，但模型训练经常受到数据有限的限制。微调大型预训练语音编码器很容易过拟合，而冻结的探针则使编码器与任务相关的知识未被充分利用。因此，我们提出了双任务向量合并（Dual Task Vector Merging），这是一种参数高效的适应方法，利用在AD任务之外学习到的任务知识来调整冻结的wav2vec 2.0主干网络。具体来说，我们将两个任务向量——这些向量是从情绪和语音识别（ASR）微调的wav2vec 2.0模型中推导出的权重增量——注入到每个Transformer层中。在AD训练期间，仅优化层级合并系数和一个线性分类头，更新的参数少于全量微调所需参数的0.1%。在ADReSS和ADReSSo数据集上的无说话人差异实验表明，双任务合并优于冻结探针、LoRA和全量微调，在主要二元设置中表现更优，并且与LoRA结合时效果最佳。在PROCESS数据集上的评估进一步表明，当与LoRA结合时，我们的优势可以迁移到三分类HC/MCI/痴呆分类任务。在减少训练数据（20%、40%和80%）条件下的实验确认了在低资源环境下可靠的优势提升。

articles.title: Learning to Program Retrievals: Composing Search Primitives via Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models increasingly use multi-step search to solve knowledge-intensive tasks, yet existing systems typically expose retrieval through fixed pipelines or collections of atomic tools. We introduce Retrieval Program Learning (RPL), a programmable search framework that allows a policy to compose search primitives into executable programs with local state and control flow. This enables adaptive search that can retrieve broadly, process intermediate results, and selectively construct model context without tying retrieval breadth to context consumption. However, the resulting flexibility creates a difficult exploration problem: useful programs may require several coordinated decisions, while reinforcement learning often supplies only sparse feedback. To address this challenge, we propose program mutation, a grammar-constrained and execution-verified procedure that generates local variants of suboptimal programs sampled during RL, converts them into training trajectories, and distills them back into the policy. We evaluate RPL on open-domain question answering and corpus-level reasoning tasks, comparing it with a range of retrieval and reasoning baselines. RPL consistently improves open-domain QA performance across model sizes and in- and out-of-domain benchmarks, with particularly large gains on multi-hop tasks. Notably, a 4B model trained with RPL outperforms all 8B model baselines. On corpus-level reasoning, RPL achieves the highest answer F1 and document-coverage F1 for both model sizes while substantially reducing context consumption and retrieval turns. Our results show that programmable search expands the retrieval strategies that agents can learn, while program mutation provides an effective mechanism for exploring useful program structures beyond direct on-policy sampling.
articles.titleCn: 通过强化学习组合搜索原语来学习编程检索
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强型语言模型越来越多地使用多步搜索来处理知识密集型任务，但现有系统通常通过固定的管道或原子工具集合来暴露检索功能。我们介绍了检索程序学习（RPL），这是一个可编程的搜索框架，允许策略将搜索原语组合成具有局部状态和控制流的可执行程序。这实现了自适应搜索，能够广泛检索、处理中间结果，并选择性地构建模型上下文，而无需将检索范围与上下文消耗绑定。然而，这种灵活性也带来了一个困难的探索问题：有用的程序可能需要多个协调决策，而强化学习通常只提供稀疏的反馈。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了程序变异，这是一种受语法约束且经过执行验证的流程，它生成在RL过程中采样的次优程序的局部变体，将它们转换为训练轨迹，并重新提炼回策略。我们在开放域问答和语料库级推理任务上评估了RPL，并与一系列检索和推理基线进行了比较。RPL在不同规模的模型和领域内外的基准测试中始终提高了开放域问答性能，特别是在多跳任务上取得了显著提升。值得注意的是，一个使用RPL训练的4B模型优于所有8B模型基线。在语料库级推理方面，RPL在两种模型规模下均实现了最高的答案F1和文档覆盖F1，同时大幅减少了上下文消耗和检索轮次。我们的结果表明，可编程搜索扩展了智能体可以学习的检索策略，而程序变异为探索有用的程序结构提供了有效的机制，超越了直接基于策略的采样。

articles.title: MisleadQA: Diagnosing LLM Failures under Misleading Context
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer questions from retrieved or user-provided context. However, provided context can be factually true yet out-of-scope, describing a different entity, time, or location from the one the question targets, and still lead models to a wrong answer. Prior work has mainly studied factually false or irrelevant context. It remains unclear whether such out-of-scope context misleads models as much as false context, and whether adding gold context prevents models from being misled by either. We introduce **MisleadQA**, a diagnostic dataset of multiple-choice questions with an abstention option. Each question pairs gold context (G) with true but out-of-scope context (S) and false but in-scope context (F) supporting the same wrong answer. We evaluate six open-weight LLMs. On questions they answer correctly without context, providing S alone leads them to switch to this wrong answer in 29.3% of cases, and providing F alone does so in 75.4%. Adding G nearly removes the effect of S, but F still misleads models in 21.0% of cases, especially when F comes first. A context-faithful instruction reduces these errors mainly through abstention and lowers accuracy even with G. These findings suggest that evaluations should check whether context applies to the question, not only whether it is true, and should report correct, misled, and abstention rates together. Data and code are available at [https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA](https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA).
articles.titleCn: MisleadQA：在误导性上下文中诊断大型语言模型失败
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）被广泛用于根据检索到的或用户提供的上下文回答问题。然而，提供的上下文可能事实正确但超出范围，描述与问题目标不同的实体、时间或地点，仍然会导致模型给出错误答案。以往的研究主要关注事实错误或无关的上下文。目前尚不清楚这种超出范围的上下文是否像错误上下文一样误导模型，以及添加正确上下文是否能防止模型被误导。我们引入**MisleadQA**，这是一个包含放弃选项的多项选择题诊断数据集。每个问题将正确但超出范围的上下文（S）与错误但范围内的上下文（F）配对，这两个上下文都支持同一个错误答案。我们评估了六个开放权重的LLMs。在这些问题上，模型在没有上下文的情况下能正确回答时，单独提供S会导致29.3%的情况切换到这个错误答案，而单独提供F会导致75.4%的情况切换。添加S几乎消除了S的影响，但F仍然在21.0%的情况下误导模型，尤其是在F先出现时。一个忠实于上下文的指令主要通过放弃来减少这些错误，即使有S，准确率也会降低。这些发现表明，评估应该检查上下文是否适用于问题，而不仅仅是它是否真实，并且应该同时报告正确、被误导和放弃率。数据和代码可在[https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA](https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA)获取。

articles.title: Efficiency Measured in English: Tokeniser Coverage Bounds Small Language Models on Indic Scripts
articles.abstract: Small Language Models with quantisation and parameter-efficient adaptation are widely offered as the route to multilingual AI under compute constraints, and their efficiency is almost always reported as a single memory figure. We show that this figure is measured in English and does not transfer. Across a 131k-sentence corpus spanning eleven Indic scripts, TinyLlama-1.1B's tokeniser emits 1.34 subword tokens per Latin-script word and 22.60 per Kannada word. This is not inefficiency; it is absence. Its vocabulary contains 0% of Odia's codepoints, 1% of Telugu's and 2% of Kannada's, and for five of eleven scripts the measured fertility sits at the UTF-8 byte-fallback ceiling, on Odia at 99.6% of it, with 93.6% of emitted tokens being raw bytes. Because SentencePiece byte fallback never raises an unknown-token marker, this failure is entirely silent: TinyLlama's UNK rate is 0.0% on every script, including the one it reads as bytes. We further show that low fertility can indicate the opposite of efficiency: mBERT posts its best score anywhere (1.10 tokens/word, on Odia) while discarding 87.9% of the text as UNK. MuRIL, an Indic-vocabulary encoder with a fifth of TinyLlama's parameters, reads every script at 1.23-2.26 tokens/word with zero UNK and zero byte fallback. The binding constraint is the vocabulary, not the parameter count. The consequence is concrete: on a 2048-token context window, the same model gives an English user 1,528 words of usable context and a Kannada user 91.
articles.titleCn: 以英语衡量效率：标记器覆盖率限制了印地语脚本的小型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 在计算资源受限的情况下，量化处理和参数高效适应的小型语言模型被广泛视为实现多语言人工智能的途径，而它们的效率几乎总是以单一内存指标来报告。我们证明该指标是在英语中测量的，并且无法迁移。在一个包含11种印度文字的13.1万句语料库中，TinyLlama-1.1B的词元器对拉丁文字母文字每个词发出1.34个亚词元，对卡纳达文字每个词发出22.60个。这不是低效；这是缺失。它的词汇表包含0%的奥里亚文字符，1%的泰卢固文字符和2%的卡纳达文字符，在11种文字中的五种，测量出的生育率达到了UTF-8字节回退上限，在奥里亚文字中达到了99.6%，其中93.6%发出的词元是原始字节。由于SentencePiece字节回退从不触发未知词标记，这种失败完全是沉默的：TinyLlama在所有文字上的未知词率均为0.0%，包括它以字节形式读取的文字。我们进一步证明，低生育率可能意味着效率的反面：mBERT在奥里亚文字上获得最佳分数（1.10个词/字），同时丢弃了87.9%的文本作为未知词。MuRIL，一个参数量只有TinyLlama五分之一印度词汇编码器，以1.23-2.26个词/字的速度读取每种文字，没有未知词，没有字节回退。约束条件是词汇表，而不是参数数量。其后果是具体的：在一个2048词元的上下文窗口中，同一模型给英语用户提供了1,528个可用的上下文词，给卡纳达用户提供了91个。

articles.title: Ask, Don't Guess: Targeted Clarification for Speech Recognition Errors
articles.abstract: Speech recognition in real time in far-field conversational settings still incurs significant errors. Identifying potential error spans during streaming ASR permits a recourse mechanism where the speaker can be asked to repeat the affected content under cleaner acoustic conditions. We propose \sysname, a new framework for online error localization, that identifies spans likely to benefit from this intervention. Our supervision uses clean audio to estimate how the recognizer's output might change under improved acoustic conditions. We probabilistically align noisy and clean decodes using a pair-HMM to obtain soft supervision. These soft targets train a counterfactual gain scorer by combining a suite of acoustic and language features to produce token-level scores, that are further grouped into spans for targeted recourse. An LLM uses the ASR transcript of the repetition to revise only the selected span. At a precision of $70\%$, \sysname achieves the highest recall by identifying up to 52\% more erroneous tokens compared to the strongest baseline. Targeted repetition yields relative WER reductions of up to 24\% under a budget that accounts for both interruption frequency and the lengths of re-uttered spans.
articles.titleCn: 提问而非猜测：针对语音识别错误的定向澄清
articles.abstractCn: 在远场对话场景中进行实时语音识别仍然存在显著错误。在流式语音识别过程中识别潜在错误片段，允许在更清晰的声学条件下请求说话人重复受影响的内容，从而提供一种补救机制。我们提出了\sysname，一个用于在线错误定位的新框架，该框架识别可能受益于这种干预的片段。我们的监督机制使用清晰语音来估计识别器输出在声学条件改善时可能发生的变化。我们使用一对隐马尔可夫模型（pair-HMM）对噪声解码和清晰解码进行概率对齐，以获得软监督。这些软目标通过结合一系列声学和语言特征来训练一个反事实增益评分器，从而生成分词级别的评分，这些评分进一步被分组为片段以进行有针对性的补救。大型语言模型（LLM）使用重复的语音识别转录本仅修改选定的片段。在70%的精度下，\sysname通过识别比最强基线多52%的错误分词实现了最高的召回率。有针对性的重复在考虑了中断频率和重述片段长度的预算下，可降低相对词错误率（WER）高达24%。

articles.title: Medical Fine-Tuning Reshapes, Not Reduces, Patient-Facing AI Risk: A Rubric-Based, LLM-Judge Evaluation Framework
articles.abstract: Patient-facing medical question answering with large language models (LLMs) is moving from research demonstrations to production deployments, yet evaluation remains anchored on factual correctness. Factuality is necessary but not sufficient: a response can be factually grounded and still issue a directive that, if acted on, would harm the patient. We introduce a risk-sensitive evaluation framework that scores responses by the presence and severity of six categories of risk-bearing language (treatment directives, contraindications, dosage expressions, urgency-triage cues, high-alert medication mentions, and overconfident assertions), anchored on published clinical harm taxonomies. Severity is classified by a three-judge LLM ensemble. We apply this framework to six 7-9B instruction-tuned models, three general (Mistral-7B, Phi-3.5-mini, Llama-3.1-8B) and three medically adapted (BioMistral-7B, OpenBioLLM-Llama3-8B, Med42-Llama3-8B), on 200 real patient questions from the K-QA benchmark. Two findings emerge. First, ensemble risk-bearing language is statistically independent of factual hallucination rate (pooled Spearman $ρ= -0.065$, $n = 300$, 95% CI $[-0.18, +0.05]$; distance correlation $= 0.10$, independence test $p = 0.24$). Second, medical fine-tuning does not reduce aggregate risk but reshapes it: continued-pretraining adaptations (BioMistral, OpenBioLLM) consistently suppress high-alert medication mentions while amplifying overconfident assertions, whereas clinical instruction-tuning (Med42) suppresses dosing only, without amplifying overconfidence. Per-category Krippendorff $α$ is fair to good for the four linguistically anchored categories (0.53-0.71) and low for the two clinical-judgment-dependent categories (0.19, 0.31), indicating where automatic safety evaluation is and is not yet reliable. We release the rubric, judge prompts, and evaluation code.
articles.titleCn: 基于评估标准的LLM裁判评估框架：医学微调重塑而非减少面向患者的AI风险
articles.abstractCn: 面向患者的医疗问答系统正从研究演示转向生产部署，但评估仍局限于事实准确性。事实准确性是必要条件但非充分条件：一个回答可能在事实上是正确的，但仍然会发出可能导致患者受伤害的指令。我们提出了一种风险敏感型评估框架，通过六类风险承担语言的六种情况（治疗指令、禁忌症、剂量表述、紧急分诊提示、高危药物提及和过度自信的断言）对回答进行评分，这些情况基于已发表的临床伤害分类法。严重程度由一个三重LLM集成进行分类。我们将该框架应用于六个7-9B指令微调模型，包括三个通用模型（Mistral-7B、Phi-3.5-mini、Llama-3.1-8B）和三个医疗适配模型（BioMistral-7B、OpenBioLLM-Llama3-8B、Med42-Llama3-8B），在K-QA基准的200个真实患者问题上进行评估。研究得出两个发现。首先，集成风险承担语言与事实性幻觉率在统计学上独立（合并Spearman $ρ= -0.065$，$n = 300$，95% CI $[-0.18, +0.05]$；距离相关性$= 0.10$，独立性检验$p = 0.24$）。其次，医疗微调并未降低总体风险，而是重新分配了风险：持续预训练的适配（BioMistral、OpenBioLLM）始终抑制高危药物提及，同时放大过度自信的断言，而临床指令微调（Med42）仅抑制剂量表述，并未放大过度自信。对于四个语言锚定的类别，Krippendorff $α$在0.53-0.71之间，表明自动安全评估在这些类别中是公平到良好的；而对于两个依赖临床判断的类别，$α$值较低（0.19、0.31），表明自动安全评估在这些类别中尚不可靠。我们发布了评分标准、裁判提示和评估代码。

articles.title: Table Serialization Determines Which Relations Language Models Preserve
articles.abstract: We study how text serialization affects table lookup in instruction-tuned language models. Our diagnostic asks the model to find the row containing a specified value under one named column, then return the value under another named column in that same row. We render the same synthetic 256-cell tables in row-major form and in column-major form with each header placed beside its values, while varying the table aspect ratio across five shapes. Across three models, the better format changes with table shape: row-major performs better on tall tables, whereas column-major performs better on wide tables. At 64 x 4, row-major leads by 42.3-54.0 percentage points; at 4 x 64, column-major leads by 35.0-59.0 points. Mapping wrong answers back to their source cells reveals a complementary error pattern: row-major tends to preserve the correct row but lose the target column, while column-major tends to preserve the correct column but lose the row. We use the term relational locality to describe this pattern: serialization keeps one relation locally available while making the other depend on positional alignment. A separate non-tabular ordering experiment supports this interpretation. Thus, apparent width-related failures in text-serialized tables depend on linearization, not table shape alone.
articles.titleCn: 表格序列化决定了语言模型保留哪些关系
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了文本序列化如何影响指令调优语言模型中的表格查找。我们的诊断要求模型在指定列下找到包含特定值的行，然后返回该行中另一指定列的值。我们以行为主和列为主两种形式渲染相同的256单元格合成表格，每个表头旁边放置其值，同时改变表格的纵横比，共五种形状。在三个模型中，更好的格式随表格形状而变化：行为主在 tall 表格中表现更好，而列为主在 wide 表格中表现更好。在 64 x 4 尺寸下，行为主领先 42.3-54.0 个百分点；在 4 x 64 尺寸下，列为主领先 35.0-59.0 个点。将错误答案映射回其源单元格揭示了互补的错误模式：行为主倾向于保留正确行但丢失目标列，而列为主倾向于保留正确列但丢失行。我们使用“关系局部性”这一术语来描述这种模式：序列化使一个关系在本地可用，而使另一个关系依赖于位置对齐。一个独立的非表格顺序实验支持这种解释。因此，文本序列化表格中看似与宽度相关的失败取决于线性化，而不仅仅是表格形状本身。

articles.title: Who Gets Unmasked? Sampler-Induced Bias in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate by gradually unmasking a canvas, so their samplers decide not only which token to write but also when to commit it. We show that this second decision changes who appears in generated text, a sampler-induced bias on top of the model's own. Common commit rules, including LLaDA's default, commit the positions whose sampled tokens are most probable; this peeking favors majority options. To separate the sampler from the model, we read the model's belief about a fork, such as a protagonist's gender, in one forward pass, and show that this belief matches exact sampling from the model. Measured against it, peeking samplers on LLaDA and Dream amplify occupational gender stereotypes and collapse opinion distributions, and confidence-based ordering shifts gender-balanced occupations toward men, more so under faster parallel decoding. We propose Fork-First Sampling, which decides the fork before anything else is written: it follows the belief or any target distribution, improves fluency, and avoids the stories that remark on the protagonist's gender, which prompt-based fixes produce, at the cost of one forward pass. Fairness evaluations of dLLMs should report the commit rule.
articles.titleCn: 谁被揭露？采样诱导的扩散语言模型偏差
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）通过逐步揭开画布来生成文本，因此它们的采样器不仅决定要写入哪个词元，还决定何时提交它。我们证明，第二个决策改变了生成文本中出现的对象，即在模型自身偏见之上引入了采样器诱导的偏见。常见的提交规则，包括LLaDA的默认规则，会提交采样概率最高的词元位置；这种窥探行为倾向于多数选项。为了将采样器与模型分离，我们在一次前向传递中读取模型对分支的信念，例如主角的性别，并证明这种信念与模型的确切采样相匹配。以此衡量，LLaDA和Dream上的窥探采样器加剧了职业性别刻板印象，并压缩了观点分布，而基于置信度的排序则将性别平衡的职业向男性倾斜，在更快的并行解码下尤为明显。我们提出了分支优先采样（Fork-First Sampling），它在任何其他内容被写入之前决定分支：它遵循信念或任何目标分布，提高流畅性，并避免基于提示修复产生的、提及主角性别的故事，代价是一次前向传递。dLLMs的公平性评估应报告提交规则。

articles.title: Information Theory of Random Composition Trees
articles.abstract: Random composition trees model the hierarchical semantic structures of meaningful texts as a statistical ensemble generated by recursively splitting texts into coherent chunks. A recent study shows that different text types can be described by random composition trees with distinct branching factors, and that the entropy rates of these trees exhibit a similar dependence across text types as the entropy rates of the actual texts. Motivated by this correspondence, we analyze information-theoretic properties of this stochastic splitting model. First, we demonstrate that the entropy of random composition trees grows linearly with the root size, and we derive an analytical expression for the entropy rate as a function of the branching factor. Second, we prove that large trees exhibit typicality: with high probability, they belong to a typical set in which each tree is approximately equally likely. Our analysis reveals that the random composition tree model shares two key information-theoretic properties of language when modeled as a stationary and ergodic stochastic process: linear entropy growth and typicality.
articles.titleCn: 随机组合树的信源理论
articles.abstractCn: 随机组合树通过递归地将文本分割成连贯的片段来模拟有意义的文本的层次化语义结构，将其视为一个统计集合。一项最新研究表明，不同类型的文本可以用具有不同分支因子的随机组合树来描述，并且这些树的熵率在不同文本类型中表现出与实际文本的熵率相似的依赖关系。受此对应关系的启发，我们分析了这种随机分割模型的信息论特性。首先，我们证明了随机组合树的熵随根节点大小线性增长，并推导出熵率作为分支因子的解析表达式。其次，我们证明了大型树表现出典型性：以高概率，它们属于一个典型集合，其中每个树出现的概率大致相等。我们的分析揭示，当语言被建模为一个平稳且遍历的随机过程时，随机组合树模型共享了语言的两个关键信息论特性：线性熵增长和典型性。

articles.title: ECHO: Efficient Causal Self-Recursion Beyond Auxiliary Multi-Token Prediction
articles.abstract: Existing Multi-token prediction (MTP) methods are auxiliary by design: the multi-horizon loss mostly trains modules attached to the backbone, and each added horizon costs another module and another pass. We propose Efficient Causal Self-Recursion (ECHO), which removes both costs. The backbone's own final layer predicts every horizon, so the supervision lands on the parameters that generate the next token, and Dynamic Depth Sampling (DDS) keeps deeper horizons affordable by drawing the training depth with probabilities that decay along depth. Future prediction thus becomes part of the autoregressive objective rather than a task attached to it, and the gains follow on both sides of it. In pretraining, added depth converts into downstream accuracy where auxiliary modules saturate, concentrating on reasoning and code at half the MTP training overhead of training every depth. At inference, the pretrained model is its own drafter: it drafts beyond the depth it was trained for, and keeps its draft-target alignment on the open-ended, high-entropy generation where post-hoc drafters lose theirs. The advantage survives a doubled token budget, a repeated pretraining run, and supervised finetuning.
articles.titleCn: ECHO：超越辅助多标记预测的高效因果自递归
articles.abstractCn: 现有的多标记预测（MTP）方法在设计上具有辅助性质：多步长损失主要训练与主干网络连接的模块，而每增加一个步长都需要额外的模块和额外的计算过程。我们提出了高效因果自递归（ECHO）方法，该方法消除了这两种成本。主干网络的最后一层预测所有步长，因此监督信息直接作用于生成下一个标记的参数，而动态深度采样（DDS）通过以随深度递减的概率选择训练深度，使更深步长保持经济性。因此，未来预测成为自回归目标的一部分，而不是附加的任务，其收益体现在目标的两侧。在预训练阶段，增加的深度转化为下游任务的准确率，而辅助模块达到饱和状态，专注于推理和代码，其训练开销仅为训练每个深度的一半。在推理阶段，预训练模型成为其自身的绘图师：它能够超出预训练时设定的深度进行预测，并在开放性高、熵值高的生成过程中保持绘图目标的一致性，而事后绘图师则丧失了这种一致性。这种优势在双倍标记预算、重复预训练运行和监督微调的情况下依然存在。

articles.title: BanglaBBQ: A Bias Benchmark for Question Answering in the Bangladeshi Context
articles.abstract: This paper introduces BanglaBBQ, a question-answering bias benchmark designed to capture stereotypes grounded in the Bangladeshi context, in both Bangla and English. Following KoBBQ and PakBBQ, BanglaBBQ adapts the original Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) by classifying its templates into three groups: directly translated (DT), modified to align target groups or contexts with Bangladesh (TM), and removed when deemed unsuitable for the Bangladeshi context (SR). This process retains 140 templates across six categories, comprising 76 DT and 64 TM templates. Five newly authored (NA) categories, based on stereotypes common in Bangladeshi society, are then added: marital status, age and political perception, regional origin, educational background, and mental-health status. Native Bangladeshi annotators judged all 466 newly authored templates, and 372 were retained because a strict majority of English annotators identified the intended target and rated the attitude as common enough. Each newly authored template is linked to a documented source and a verbatim quote from it. Each evaluated template also has a counter-stereotypical version of its disambiguated context. The dataset was evaluated using two open-weight models (Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B) and two closed models (GPT-4.1-mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash). All four lean towards the stereotyped person when the context is ambiguous, in both languages, and the effect of language differs by model, so English results do not predict behaviour in Bangla. On the adapted BBQ templates, both Qwen3 models are also less accurate when the context contradicts a stereotype than when it confirms it. On the newly authored templates, the closed models follow counter-stereotypical evidence almost perfectly, and all four models are more biased on the templates that annotators validated than on those they rejected.
articles.titleCn: 孟加拉烧烤：孟加拉语环境下问答的偏见基准
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了BanglaBBQ，这是一个旨在捕捉孟加拉国背景下刻板印象的问题回答偏差基准，包含孟加拉语和英语两种语言。继KoBBQ和PakBBQ之后，BanglaBBQ通过将原始问题回答偏差基准（BBQ）的模板分为三类来适应BBQ：直接翻译（DT）、修改以使目标群体或背景与孟加拉国一致（TM）以及因被认为不适合孟加拉国背景而删除（SR）。这个过程保留了跨越六个类别的140个模板，其中包括76个DT模板和64个TM模板。然后添加了基于孟加拉国社会中常见刻板印象的五个新创作的（NA）类别：婚姻状况、年龄和政治观念、地域来源、教育背景和心理健康状况。本地孟加拉语标注者对所有466个新创作的模板进行了评判，其中372个被保留，因为大多数英语标注者识别了预期的目标并认为态度足够普遍。每个新创作的模板都与一个记录在案的来源及其逐字引文相关联。每个评估的模板还包含其消歧背景的反刻板印象版本。该数据集使用两个开放式权重模型（Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B）和两个封闭式模型（GPT-4.1-mini和Gemini 2.5 Flash）进行了评估。在两种语言中，当背景模糊时，所有四个模型都倾向于刻板印象化的人，并且语言对模型的影响不同，因此英语结果不能预测孟加拉语的行为。在修改后的BBQ模板上，当背景与刻板印象矛盾时，Qwen3模型也不如背景确认刻板印象时准确。在新创作的模板上，封闭式模型几乎完美地遵循反刻板印象的证据，并且所有四个模型在标注者验证的模板上的偏见程度高于被标注者拒绝的模板。

articles.title: GLOSS-MT: Controllable Low-Resource Machine Translation with an Editable Dictionary
articles.abstract: Adapting a pretrained machine translation (MT) model to new terminology usually requires new parallel data and another round of fine-tuning, which is costly for low-resource languages. We ask whether controllability can be added to MT, and the fine-tuning burden reduced, without degrading the pretrained model. GLOSS-MT looks up the source's noun phrases in an offline English-Twi dictionary, replaces every phrase found by its Twi translation in place, and fine-tunes a translation model once to translate these mixed inputs. We apply the same data and pipeline to NLLB-200 (600M, 1.3B, 3.3B), OPUS-MT en-tw and TranslateGemma 4B. On a document-level English-to-Asante Twi benchmark (84 documents, four domains), every fine-tune scores above its pretrained base in chrF2 (+2.85 to +5.48), and the three NLLB fine-tunes are the best open systems (50.12-50.80). A direct controllability test on human-translated Bible passages shows that the three fine-tunes tested write 79-97% of the dictionary terms, and that replacing every dictionary entry by a different term changes the output accordingly (70-97% of the new terms appear) with no retraining. We release the models, data and code.
articles.comment: 4 pages, 2 tables. Models: https://huggingface.co/ghanaopenai ; code: https://github.com/GhanaOpenAI/gloss-mt
articles.titleCn: GLOSS-MT：一种具有可编辑词典的可控低资源机器翻译
articles.abstractCn: 将预训练的机器翻译（MT）模型适应新术语通常需要新的平行数据并进行另一轮微调，这对低资源语言来说成本高昂。我们探究是否可以在MT中增加可控性，同时减少微调负担而不损害预训练模型。GLOSS-MT在离线的英语-图维词典中查找源文本的名词短语，将其替换为相应的图维语翻译，并对翻译模型进行一次微调以翻译这些混合输入。我们使用相同的数据和流程应用于NLLB-200（600M、1.3B、3.3B）、OPUS-MT en-tw和TranslateGemma 4B。在一个包含84份文档、涵盖四个领域的英语到阿桑特图维语基准测试中，每次微调的chrF2得分均高于其预训练基础模型（+2.85至+5.48），其中三个NLLB微调是当前最佳公开系统（50.12-50.80）。在人类翻译的圣经段落上的直接可控性测试显示，所测试的三个微调写入了79-97%的词典术语，并且将每个词典条目替换为不同术语时，输出会相应变化（新术语出现率为70-97%），无需重新训练。我们发布了模型、数据和代码。

articles.title: PV-Decoding: Progressive Verification Decoding with Decode Gating for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.
articles.titleCn: PV解码：具有解码门控的渐进式验证解码，用于扩散语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）通过并行更新多个标记，为自回归生成提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案，但其推理效率仍受限于安全提交试探性预测的成本。特别是，dLLMs的推测解码具有挑战性，因为同一扩散块内的推测标记可能相互依赖，导致激进接受容易产生错误传播，而严格验证在计算上则非常昂贵。我们提出了PV-Decoding，这是一种基于置信度的推测解码框架，用于块扩散推理，并具有渐进式验证。PV-Decoding使用两个置信度阈值将掩码位置划分为直接解码标记、推测标记和未解决标记，然后使用逐渐增强的策略验证推测标记，包括单批处理、双批处理和多批处理验证。这种设计暴露了一个实用的准确率-效率权衡：较弱的验证最小化开销，而较强的验证提高了接受精度和鲁棒性。在GSM8K、MBPP和HumanEval上的三个扩散语言模型实验表明，与基于置信度的解码相比，PV-Decoding减少了顺序模型前向传递（MFPs）8%--37%，同时将观察到的最大准确率下降控制在1.3%。在Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K上，在相同的硬件预算下，PV-Decoding（1批处理）和PV-Decoding（2批处理）将吞吐量提高了7.0%--13.6%，而PV-Decoding（多批处理）在当前运行时则较慢。这些结果表明，基于置信度的推测结合结构化验证是实现高效可靠的dLLM推理的实用途径。

articles.title: Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
articles.abstract: Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent's context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. Models of cortical circuits suggest a principle for addressing this imbalance: inhibition can selectively suppress shared inputs while preserving sensitivity to weaker signals. We adapt this principle into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each evidence sentence and receiver. Each round, it forwards evidence sentences restated in agents' messages, delivering each at most once to receivers whose own evidence lacks it and excluding the senders' reasoning and answers. Against standard message passing, accuracy in peer groups rose by 39-77 percentage points across three benchmarks, and tokens per run fell by 10-46%. Gains held across seven open models spanning four to thirty-two billion parameters and two commercial models, in groups up to sixty-four agents, and across multi-agent architectures including peer-to-peer, orchestrator-worker, and multilevel hierarchical organizations. These findings support a scalable design pattern for more accurate and token-efficient multi-agent reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 基于神经网络的抑制消息传递，用于精确且高效的多人智能体推理
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体系统通过整合任何单个智能体都无法触及的信息来解决问题。检索和工具使用可以将这些信息分布到各个智能体，使沟通成为协作的关键。一个核心挑战是随着消息的累积，在各个智能体的上下文中保持关键证据的可视性。重复信息可能会挤占罕见但决定性的证据。大脑皮层电路模型提出了解决这种不平衡的原则：抑制可以选择性抑制共享输入，同时保持对较弱信号的敏感性。我们将这一原则应用于抑制性消息传递，这是一种无需训练的通信路由器，它为每个证据句子和接收者单独取消冗余证据。每一轮，它转发智能体消息中重述的证据句子，最多一次地向缺少该证据的接收者传递每个证据，并排除发送者的推理和答案。与标准消息传递相比，在三个基准测试中，同侪组中的准确率提高了39-77个百分点，每轮的token数量减少了10-46%。这些收益在涵盖四到三百二十亿参数的七个开放模型、两个商业模型、最多包含六十四个智能体的同侪组以及包括点对点、协调器-工作器和多级分层组织在内的多智能体架构中均得以保持。这些发现支持了一种可扩展的设计模式，用于实现更准确和token效率更高的多智能体推理。

articles.title: DiffuPlan: Editable Planning State for Diffusion Language Model Agents
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) are emerging as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, yet dLLM agents largely inherit an interaction protocol designed for AR generation: once intermediate state is written, later observations can only be incorporated by appending more text. This is a poor match to a defining capability of dLLMs -- reconstructing earlier text conditioned on context that appears both before and after it. We ask whether this capability can support a different agent-state paradigm in which intermediate planning state is directly revisable as evidence arrives. We introduce DiffuPlan, a diffusion search agent that maintains a single editable planning state and reconstructs only the affected steps when later evidence resolves an entity or changes the search route. To support variable-length revisions, we introduce Expansion-Partition Marginalization (EPM), which marginalizes over equivalent expansion paths. We further adapt diffusion trajectory RL to multi-turn search. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, DiffuPlan achieves 50.24 average F1, outperforming strong AR search agents. More importantly, under identical data and training, editable planning state improves the diffusion agent by 2.44 F1 versus only 0.47 for its AR source model. These results show that dLLMs need not imitate append-only AR agents: revising committed state is a distinct agentic advantage.
articles.titleCn: DiffuPlan：用于扩散语言模型代理的可编辑规划状态
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）正作为一种自回归（AR）语言模型的替代方案而兴起，但dLLM智能体很大程度上继承了为AR生成设计的交互协议：一旦中间状态被写入，后续观察结果只能通过追加更多文本来整合。这与dLLM的一项核心能力——基于出现在其前后文中的上下文重建早期文本——存在明显不匹配。我们探究这种能力是否能够支持一种不同的智能体状态范式，其中中间规划状态可以直接随着证据的出现而修订。我们引入了DiffuPlan，这是一种扩散搜索智能体，它维护单个可编辑的规划状态，并且仅当后续证据澄清实体或改变搜索路线时才重建受影响的步骤。为了支持可变长度的修订，我们引入了扩展-划分边缘化（EPM），该技术对等价扩展路径进行边缘化。我们进一步将扩散轨迹RL适配到多轮搜索中。在四个多跳问答基准测试中，DiffuPlan实现了50.24的平均F1值，优于强大的AR搜索智能体。更重要的是，在相同数据和训练条件下，可编辑的规划状态将扩散智能体的F1值提高了2.44，而其AR源模型的提升仅为0.47。这些结果表明，dLLMs无需模仿仅追加文本的AR智能体：修订已确认状态是一种独特的智能体优势。

articles.title: When Do Repetition Loops Lock? Truncation Sampling, Bounded Penalties, and a Blind Spot in DRY
articles.abstract: Language models sometimes repeat verbatim until the generation limit. We study the exit rather than the entrance: given that a span has already been repeated $n$ times, when is escape still possible? Along the loop the context is deterministic, so loop survival under any sampler can be computed exactly from one forward pass. Pure sampling leaves a positive escape probability at every step; top-$p$ with threshold $π>1/2$ locks a position exactly when the continuation probability reaches $π$. A bounded penalty can leave a position locked; a penalty that outgrows the model's preference for the loop over unseen tokens guarantees escape under top-$p$. The same analysis predicts a blind spot in the widely deployed DRY sampler: its sequence breakers cap the penalty at $λb^{g-1-a}$ for loops whose longest breaker-free run has $g$ tokens. On eleven open models, 66\% of locked units with $g=6$ stay locked under DRY and 1\% with $g=8$. In free generation with llama.cpp, all 109 loops that survive DRY have $g\le 7$. We propose DRY-C, which adds a term that grows exponentially with the number of verbatim recurrences, up to its look-back window. With it, none of 720 structured-output generations looped to the length limit, and task completion stayed close to DRY's.
articles.titleCn: 重复循环何时锁定？截断采样、有界惩罚以及DRY中的一个盲点
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型有时会在生成限制之前重复内容。我们研究的是退出而非进入：当一段内容已经重复了n次时，何时仍然有可能逃脱？沿着循环，上下文是确定的，因此任何采样器下的循环存活情况都可以通过一次前向传递精确计算。纯采样在每个步骤都留下正的逃脱概率；而阈值大于1/2的top-p采样在延续概率达到π时精确锁定位置。一个有界的惩罚可能锁定位置；一个超过模型对循环相对于未见过标记的偏好的惩罚，在top-p采样下保证逃脱。同样的分析预测了广泛部署的DRY采样器存在一个盲点：其序列打破者将惩罚限制在λb^{g-1-a}，对于最长无打破者运行为g个标记的循环。在11个公开模型中，66%的g=6的锁定单元在DRY下保持锁定，而g=8的只有1%。在llama.cpp的自由生成中，所有109个存活DRY的循环都有g≤7。我们提出了DRY-C，它增加了一个随逐字重复次数指数增长的项，直到其回溯窗口。使用它，720个结构化输出生成没有循环到长度限制，任务完成度也接近DRY。

articles.title: Verifying Human-Written Reasoning References
articles.abstract: Evaluating the reasoning of AI systems often relies on human-written reasoning chains as references, yet the logical support for their individual steps is rarely verified. Although prior neuro-symbolic approaches have formalized and checked reasoning, their reported evaluations do not systematically assess whether step conclusions in human-written reference derivations are entailed by their cited premise sets or investigate the sources of failures in those references. To address these limitations, we present a novel reference-centred assessment method for human-written derivations that combines entailment checking against cited premise sets, full-premise rechecking, and failure attribution to examine the reliability of these derivations and their formal representations. We evaluate it on P-FOLIO, using a large language model (LLM) to translate step conclusions into first-order logic (FOL) and the Z3 SMT solver to check entailment. Of 386 derivations examined, 202 (52.3%) meet all our checking criteria, meaning that every translated step is entailed by its stated support and the required target is established under the available FOL representations. Among 230 steps not entailed by their stated support, 191 become entailed when checked against the complete original premises, indicating that most initial failures reflect incomplete or mismatched support rather than unsupported claims. Manual analysis of the remaining 39 cases identifies 21 human reasoning errors, 11 FOL translation errors, and 7 dataset annotation errors. A separate manual audit of 50 randomly sampled steps that passed the entailment checks found 46 faithful FOL translations (92%). These findings suggest that disagreement with a human-written reasoning reference may originate in the reference or its formal representation rather than in the AI system being evaluated.
articles.titleCn: 验证人类编写推理参考
articles.abstractCn: 评估AI系统的推理能力通常依赖于人类编写的推理链作为参考，但对其每个步骤的逻辑支持却很少得到验证。尽管先前的神经符号方法已经形式化和检查了推理过程，但它们报告的评估并未系统地评估人类编写的参考推导中步骤结论是否由其引用的前提集所蕴含，也未调查这些参考中失败的来源。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种以参考为中心的评估方法，用于检验人类编写的推导，该方法结合了对引用前提集的蕴含检查、完整前提重新检查以及失败归因，以评估这些推导及其形式化表示的可靠性。我们在P-FOLIO数据集上评估了该方法，使用大型语言模型（LLM）将步骤结论翻译为一阶逻辑（FOL），并使用Z3 SMT求解器检查蕴含关系。在检查的386个推导中，有202个（52.3%）满足所有检查标准，这意味着每个翻译后的步骤都由其声明的支持所蕴含，并且在可用的FOL表示下建立了所需的目标。在230个未由其声明的支持所蕴含的步骤中，有191个在对照完整原始前提后变得蕴含，这表明大多数初始失败反映的是支持不完整或不匹配，而非无根据的主张。对剩余39个案例的手动分析识别出21个人类推理错误、11个FOL翻译错误和7个数据集标注错误。对通过蕴含检查的50个随机抽样的步骤进行的单独手动审计发现，有46个（92%）是忠实的一阶逻辑翻译。这些结果表明，与人类编写的推理参考不一致可能源于参考本身或其形式化表示，而非被评估的AI系统。

articles.title: Do Conversational Agents Need Explicit Memory? A Controlled Comparison with Raw-History Retrieval
articles.abstract: Explicit memory systems transform conversation history into persistent representations intended to improve future access, often at substantial construction cost. Yet it remains unclear whether this added complexity yields better answer accuracy than retrieving directly from raw history. This study compares six state-of-the-art explicit memory systems with raw-history RAG on LongMemEval-S and BEAM-100K under original and controlled retrieval settings. We find only localized gains for particular question types and tight run-time context budgets, with no consistent advantage over strong raw-history RAG baselines. Oracle retrieval shows that some systems fail to preserve answer-supporting information during explicit memory construction, while others preserve it but fail to retrieve it effectively, despite construction costs reaching hours per conversation. Our findings suggest that while many existing memory systems for AI agents emphasize increasingly elaborate explicit memory construction, they are often evaluated without strong controlled comparisons to raw-history RAG and may underemphasize retrieval. Retrieval remains a major bottleneck when useful information is preserved, suggesting that improving access to existing information may be at least as important as constructing richer explicit memory.
articles.titleCn: 对话代理是否需要显式记忆？与原始历史检索的对照实验
articles.abstractCn: 显式记忆系统将对话历史转化为持久性表示，旨在提升未来访问效率，但通常伴随着高昂的构建成本。然而，目前尚不清楚这种增加的复杂性是否比直接从原始历史中检索更能提高答案准确性。本研究在LongMemEval-S和BEAM-100K数据集上，在原始检索和受控检索设置下，比较了六种最先进的显式记忆系统与原始历史RAG。我们发现，仅在特定问题类型和严格的运行时上下文预算下才观察到局部增益，且在强原始历史RAG基线之上并无持续优势。通过或然检索实验表明，某些系统在显式记忆构建过程中未能保留答案支持信息，而另一些系统虽然保留了信息，却未能有效检索，尽管构建成本高达每对话数小时。我们的研究结果表明，尽管许多现有的AI代理记忆系统强调日益复杂的显式记忆构建，但它们往往缺乏与原始历史RAG的强受控比较，且可能低估了检索的重要性。当有用信息被保留时，检索仍然是一个主要瓶颈，这表明改进现有信息的访问能力可能至少与构建更丰富的显式记忆同等重要。

articles.title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. Sparse replacement also retains much of the base model's diversity while staying close to the RL model at pass@1. At k=256, it solves 67.5% of the problems, significantly more than the RL model (61.4%) and a mixture of whole responses matched in pass@1 (61.45%). The comparison is at equal attempt counts rather than equal compute, since rl-replace consults both models at every decoding step. These results show that the opening can recover a meaningful part of the RL gain, but a larger contribution comes from later choices, which can be borrowed while retaining much of the base model's diversity. Code is available at https://github.com/CyrusZhang04/WhatRLBrings.
articles.titleCn: 强化学习为推理带来的启示：基础模型本不会做出的几个决策
articles.abstractCn: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了数学推理能力，但其对基础模型的具体贡献尚不明确。我们通过一系列生成时干预措施对Qwen3-4B-Base进行研究，测量每个干预措施在其RL训练版本上的收益程度，并在120道AIME问题上进行评估。采用相同的8,192个token输出限制的强力采样并未带来贪婪解码之外的增益。然而，仅在两个模型的贪婪选择不同时借用RL模型的token，大约4%的生成位置就能恢复90.5%的pass@1增益，在MATH-500上的三个模型对中也观察到类似的恢复效果。我们发现即使是单个起始token也具有显著影响：强制基础模型以“Alright”开头能恢复35%的RL增益。然而，仅靠起始部分是不够的。在相同起始部分后的后续替换能再增加5.2个百分点提升pass@1，而我们测试的插入反思性词汇（如“Wait”）的固定规则无法复制这种效益。稀疏替换在保持接近RL模型在pass@1上的表现的同时，也保留了基础模型的大部分多样性。在k=256时，它能解决67.5%的问题，显著高于RL模型（61.4%）和匹配pass@1的完整响应混合（61.45%）。由于rl-replace在每一步解码中都咨询两个模型，因此这里的比较是基于相同的尝试次数而非相同的计算量。这些结果表明，起始部分可以恢复RL增益的一部分有意义的内容，但更大的贡献来自后续选择，这些选择可以在保留基础模型大部分多样性的同时被借鉴。代码可在https://github.com/CyrusZhang04/WhatRLBrings获取。

articles.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
articles.abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.
articles.titleCn: Muse Glimmer 30B：一个设备端代理模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Muse Glimmer，一个开源的30B参数因果语言模型，配备了感知编码器，专门为在消费级硬件上执行自主代理任务而设计。Muse Glimmer将多步推理、可靠工具使用和故障恢复集成到一个模型中，该模型可在消费级设备上本地运行，无需云基础设施。该模型接受文本和图像输入，并生成文本输出，在超过一百种语言的数据上进行了训练，并量化为大约4位精度，以实现高效的单GPU推理。Muse Glimmer在其尺寸类别中取得了最先进的性能，在工具使用、多步规划和代理任务完成方面，与Gemma4-31B和Qwen3.6-27B等同类模型相比，树立了新的标准。我们以Apache 2.0许可证发布该模型，以促进具备能力、安全、本地AI代理的开源开发。

articles.title: Safety Kernel: Mechanistic Alignment for Cross-Lingual Defense in LLMs
articles.abstract: The safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are highly uneven across different languages, often allowing cross-lingual attacks to bypass safety guardrails. Existing alignment methods predominantly rely on external alignment signals and provide limited insight into underlying neuron-level mechanisms, making it difficult to provide a unified internal target for cross-lingual safety interventions. To address this, we analyze cross-lingual safety behavior at the neuron level and identify a compact set of safety-related neurons shared across languages, termed the safety kernel (SK). Specifically, we first utilize multilingual parallel safe and unsafe prompts to compute safety contrast with activation responsiveness (SCAR) scores, identifying language-wise safety-neuron candidates from internal activation patterns. We then intersect the resulting language-wise safety-neuron sets to obtain the SK, and validate its functional relevance to cross-lingual safety behavior through activation suppression and activation-state transfer interventions. Finally, building on the SK coordinates, we introduce SK-Masked LoRA, which constrains LoRA adaptation to the feed-forward network (FFN) output dimensions corresponding to the SK, thereby focusing safety-related changes on the cross-lingually shared neuron coordinates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SK-Masked LoRA substantially reduces attack success rates across multiple languages, including languages excluded from SK discovery, while intervening on only a small fraction of internal neuron coordinates and producing generally limited changes in the model's general capabilities.
articles.titleCn: 安全内核：跨语言防御中的LLM机制对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在不同语言中的安全能力差异极大，常常允许跨语言攻击绕过安全防护机制。现有的对齐方法主要依赖外部对齐信号，且对底层神经元级机制缺乏深入洞察，难以提供统一内部目标以进行跨语言安全干预。为解决这一问题，我们分析了跨语言安全行为在神经元层面的表现，并识别出跨语言共享的一组紧凑安全相关神经元，称之为安全内核（SK）。具体而言，我们首先利用多语言平行安全与不安全提示计算安全对比激活响应（SCAR）分数，从内部激活模式中识别出语言相关的安全神经元候选。随后，我们交集得到的语言相关安全神经元集以获得SK，并通过激活抑制与激活状态迁移干预验证其与跨语言安全行为的功能相关性。最后，基于SK坐标，我们引入SK掩码LoRA，该技术约束LoRA适应于对应于SK的前馈网络（FFN）输出维度，从而将安全相关变化集中于跨语言共享的神经元坐标。大量实验表明，SK掩码LoRA显著降低了跨多种语言（包括SK发现过程中排除的语言）的攻击成功率，仅需干预少量内部神经元坐标，且对模型整体能力的影响有限。

articles.title: Training with Ciphers to Enhance In-Context Terminology Learning For Translation from Rare Languages
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. Probes using synonyms, nonce words and controls for shared surface context show that these gains come from linking source terms to their in-context translations rather than from shortcuts.
articles.titleCn: 使用密码训练以增强稀有语言翻译的上下文术语学习
articles.abstractCn: 使用情境示例（IC-Train）微调大型语言模型（LLMs）使翻译模型能够在部署时适应新的平行数据，但尚不清楚它们是否真正从这些示例中学习到罕见术语的翻译。我们将这种能力形式化为情境术语学习（ICTL）。我们证明标准的IC-Train仅微弱地发展这种能力，并提出RareCipherFT，它在不使用任何词汇资源的情况下增强了这种能力。RareCipherFT将每个训练目标与共享罕见术语的情境示例配对。然后，它在上下文和参考中替换该术语为字符打乱的密码，以便该术语只能通过从上下文中复制来恢复。加密的训练数据比例逐渐减少以保持翻译质量。在英语与泰米尔语、阿萨姆语、米佐语、尼泊尔语和豪萨语之间的七个翻译方向，以及四个参数从1B到7B的模型中，RareCipherFT将标准IC-Train的术语召回率提高了5-15个绝对点，同时没有降低COMET分数。使用同义词、临时词和控制共享表面上下文的探测表明，这些提升来自于将源术语与其情境翻译相关联，而不是来自捷径。

articles.title: ASR Personalization in Pathological Voice: Accuracy, Efficiency, and Duration Effects
articles.abstract: Automatic Speech recognition (ASR) struggles with Pathological speech due to persistent speaker-specific mismatch. In clinical and accessibility scenarios, only limited target-speaker data is typically available, making full model retraining impractical. We present a component-level analysis of LoRA adaptation in Whisper, investigating how adapter placement interacts with the model size, training efficiency and utterance-duration in single-speaker settings. Our experimental comparative study shows that while scaling reduces errors, it does not eliminate mismatch. Furthermore, the full attention LoRa provides the most reliable accuracy, and the best time--accuracy trade-off. Improvements vary across utterance length, with medium-length recordings benefiting the most, while short and long utterances remain challenging. These findings highlight the importance of adaptation placement and duration-dependent evaluation, under challenging, data-scarce personalization scenarios.
articles.titleCn: 病理语音中的ASR个性化：准确性、效率及持续时间效应
articles.abstractCn: 自动语音识别（ASR）在处理病理语音时面临挑战，主要原因是持续的说话人特定不匹配。在临床和辅助功能场景中，通常只有有限的目标说话人数据可用，使得完整模型再训练不切实际。我们针对Whisper中的LoRA适应进行了组件级分析，研究了适配器放置如何与模型大小、训练效率和单说话人设置中的话语持续时间相互作用。我们的实验比较研究显示，虽然规模扩展可以减少错误，但并不能消除不匹配。此外，全注意力LoRa提供了最可靠的准确性和最佳的时间-准确率权衡。改进程度因话语长度而异，中等长度的录音受益最大，而短话语和长话语仍然具有挑战性。这些发现突出了适配器放置和持续时间依赖评估的重要性，特别是在具有挑战性、数据稀缺的个人化场景中。

articles.title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
articles.abstract: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. We further use these features to analyze model representations during jailbreak attacks, mathematical and agentic reasoning. Our targeted feature construction thus offers a scalable route to studying concepts in language models, potentially extending to millions of features across arbitrary domains.
articles.titleCn: 从故事到特写：为AI对齐与可解释性扩展概念向量
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究特征向量：语言模型激活空间中对应人类可解释概念的方向，例如诚实或欺骗。现有的无监督方法，如稀疏自编码器，试图恢复整个特征空间，但往往以牺牲特征质量和可解释性为代价。我们采取更务实的路线：专注于与人工智能安全和对齐相关的概念，我们生成合成概念-对立故事对，并使用它们平均模型激活的差异作为特征向量。我们使用跨越多种语言和体裁的200万个合成故事，将这种方法扩展到1036个与对齐相关的概念，并公开发布。在来自三个模型系列的六个模型中，我们的特征向量可靠地泛化到检测聊天对话和网络文本中的相应概念。它们形成了一个跨模型共享的可解释几何结构，并在注入激活时可以因果地引导模型行为。我们进一步使用这些特征来分析模型在越狱攻击、数学和代理推理过程中的表示。因此，我们针对性的特征构建为研究语言模型中的概念提供了一条可扩展的途径，有可能扩展到任意领域的数百万个特征。

articles.title: EGIP: An Evidence-Grounded Interaction Protocol for Clinical Agents
articles.abstract: Interactive clinical agents acquire evidence through patient dialogue and diagnostic examinations, yet their performance also depends on how the interaction environment exposes information, available actions, and examination results. When these conditions are implicit or inconsistently controlled, final-answer accuracy can conflate diagnostic reasoning with the effects of the interaction protocol. We propose the \textbf{E}vidence-\textbf{G}rounded \textbf{I}nteraction \textbf{P}rotocol (EGIP), which enforces role-specific information boundaries, exposes diagnostic actions without revealing their results, retrieves examination results from stored clinical records, and organizes acquired evidence for final decision-making. By separating evidence acquisition from terminal prediction, EGIP enables different decision strategies to operate on the same observations. We evaluate EGIP across two clinical-agent frameworks, five datasets, and six language models. EGIP improves diagnostic accuracy over native baselines across all primary comparisons. A clinician review further shows that the proportion of automatically scored correct responses jointly judged evidence-supported rises from 10.20\% to 36.55\%. These findings support the effectiveness of EGIP as a unified interaction protocol for improving clinical-agent performance through controlled evidence access and acquisition.
articles.titleCn: 基于证据的临床智能体交互协议：EGIP
articles.abstractCn: 交互式临床智能体通过患者对话和诊断检查获取证据，但其性能也取决于交互环境如何呈现信息、可用操作以及检查结果。当这些条件隐含或不一致控制时，最终答案的准确性可能将诊断推理与交互协议的影响混淆。我们提出了\textbf{E}vidence-\textbf{G}rounded \textbf{I}nteraction \textbf{P}rotocol (EGIP)，该协议强制执行特定角色的信息边界，在不泄露结果的情况下暴露诊断操作，从存储的临床记录中检索检查结果，并组织获取的证据以供最终决策。通过将证据获取与终端预测分离，EGIP使不同的决策策略能够在相同的观察结果上运行。我们在两个临床智能体框架、五个数据集和六个语言模型上评估了EGIP。EGIP在所有主要比较中都提高了诊断准确性。临床医生审查进一步表明，自动评分的正确回答中，被共同判定为有证据支持的比例从10.20\%上升到36.55\%。这些发现支持EGIP作为统一交互协议的有效性，通过控制证据访问和获取来提高临床智能体性能。

articles.title: Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning
articles.abstract: Recent research-level physics-reasoning benchmarks for LLMs reveal a failure mode that lies not in knowledge or execution, but in modeling the world being reasoned about. Models often silently alter given quantities, fabricate laws, or inject unstated assumptions to force a problem into familiar patterns, and then reason inside this corrupted world. We define this premise-level divergence as modeling drift: the gap between a model's internal axiomatic world model (AWM) and the true physical world specified in the problem. Although RLVR and PRM have yielded substantial gains in mathematics and code, their reward shapes do not directly supervise world modeling in axiomatic domains such as physics. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Axiomatic World Modeling (RLAWM), which optimizes the policy by penalizing divergence between its inferred axiomatic world model and the true physics world. RLAWM probes physics reasoning at two hierarchical levels (modeling and solving), each scored by a physically grounded reward. The modeling reward targets abstract knowledge formulation, evaluating whether the model captures the true axiomatic world before attempting calculation. The solving reward targets instantiated knowledge reasoning, checking whether the model's concrete derivation remains consistent with the axiomatic world. This two-level structure separates what world the model believes it is reasoning in from how it reasons within that world. The framework operates exclusively during training, with no extra cost during inference. RLAWM improves performance by up to +12.2 points on PhysReason and +5.2 on PHYSICS over the baseline. It also generalizes zero-shot across difficulty, source, and domain, with a 2.45x gain and +10 points over the strongest baseline on olympiad-level physics and math.
articles.titleCn: 基于公理的世界建模用于物理推理
articles.abstractCn: 近期针对大型语言模型（LLM）的物理推理基准测试表明，其失效模式并非源于知识或执行能力，而是在于对所推理世界的建模。模型常常在无声中改变给定量、编造定律或注入未声明的假设，以将问题强行纳入熟悉模式，并在这一被污染的世界中进行推理。我们将这种前提层面的偏差定义为建模漂移：即模型内部公理化世界模型（AWM）与问题中指定的真实物理世界之间的差距。尽管RLVR和PRM在数学和代码方面取得了显著提升，但它们的奖励形状并未直接监督物理等公理化领域的世界建模。我们提出了基于公理化世界建模的强化学习（RLAWM），通过惩罚其推断的公理化世界模型与真实物理世界之间的偏差来优化策略。RLAWM在两个层级（建模和求解）上探测物理推理，每个层级均由基于物理的奖励进行评分。建模奖励旨在抽象知识表述，评估模型在尝试计算前是否捕捉了真实的公理化世界。求解奖励旨在实例化知识推理，检查模型的具象推导是否与公理化世界保持一致。这种双层结构将模型所认为的推理世界与其在该世界中的推理方式区分开来。该框架仅在训练期间运行，推理时无需额外成本。RLAWM在PhysReason上提升了高达+12.2分的性能，在PHYSICS上提升了+5.2分，且在难度、来源和领域上实现了零样本泛化，在奥林匹克级别的物理和数学任务中，相较于最强基线实现了2.45倍的增益和+10分的提升。

articles.title: ProbePO: Sparse Probes, Redistributed Credit for Critic-Free LLM Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns one terminal reward to an entire reasoning trajectory, obscuring how individual reasoning steps contributed to the outcome. GRPO broadcasts a group-normalized advantage to every response token, while finer-grained approaches often rely on dense auxiliary rollouts or branching schemes that can also alter the data used for policy updates. We cast the missing middle as budgeted measurement: with a limited rollout budget, which partial solutions should be evaluated, and how should their value estimates refine credit? ProbePO selects partial-solution states with a reward-free uncertainty score and estimates their expected verifier rewards under a capped continuation budget. ProbePO redistributes, rather than replaces, GRPO's trajectory-level advantage across tokens while preserving each trajectory's mean token-level advantage; probe continuations serve only as measurements. Across three DeepSeekMath and Qwen-family models spanning 1.5B-7B parameters, ProbePO consistently outperforms GRPO and achieves the highest accuracy among the four evaluated methods in 16 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Against dense-probing VinePPO on DeepSeekMath-7B, ProbePO achieves higher accuracy on all six benchmarks with 76% less end-to-end training time.
articles.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training
articles.titleCn: ProbePO：稀疏探针，无评价值大语言模型强化学习的重新分配信用
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励的强化学习为整个推理轨迹分配一个终端奖励，模糊了单个推理步骤如何对结果做出贡献。GRPO向每个响应标记广播一个组归一化的优势，而更细粒度的方法通常依赖于密集的辅助展开或分支方案，这些方案也可能改变用于策略更新的数据。我们将缺失的中间环节视为预算化测量：在有限的展开预算下，应该评估哪些部分解决方案，以及它们的价值估计应如何细化信用？ProbePO选择具有无奖励不确定性分数的部分解决方案状态，并在限制的延续预算下估计它们的预期验证者奖励。ProbePO重新分配而不是替换GRPO的轨迹级优势到标记上，同时保留每个轨迹的标记级优势均值；探测延续仅作为测量。在三个参数范围从1.5B到7B的DeepSeekMath和Qwen系列模型中，ProbePO始终优于GRPO，并在18次模型基准比较中的16次中实现了最高准确率。在DeepSeekMath-7B上与密集探测的VinePPO相比，ProbePO在所有六个基准测试中实现了更高的准确率，且端到端训练时间减少了76%。

articles.title: Backend-Frontend Converter: Component-Based Conversion of .NET Computational Models to TypeScript
articles.abstract: Computational models developed in .NET often need to run locally within web applications. We present Backend--Frontend Converter, an architecture for generating TypeScript implementations of component-based models. The converter maps components, connections, aliases, and formula trees to model-specific TypeScript code. Reusable runtime libraries provide numerical integration, data access, and state handling. We evaluate stored generated implementations through four orbital scenarios and a recorded trading-strategy comparison. Orbital calculations execute in a browser and are paired with C\# results by crossing event and timestamp; trading outputs are aligned by date. Analytic scheduler tests and deliberately perturbed outputs assess the validation procedure. Each orbital scenario produces 91 paired events with identical timestamps. Position and velocity differences remain below $(10^{-6}\)~km$ and $(10^{-9}\)~km/s$. All 20 analytic scheduler checks pass, and the comparator detects each of three prescribed state and time perturbations. The trading comparison contains 501 aligned daily records with matching indicator values, positions, and order events. The evaluated implementations preserve the compared outputs across the C#/TypeScript boundary. Component-specific generation and reusable execution libraries provide a practical route from supported .NET computational models to TypeScript applications.
articles.titleCn: 后端-前端转换器：基于组件的.NET计算模型转换为TypeScript
articles.abstractCn: 在.NET中开发的计算模型通常需要在本地Web应用程序中运行。我们提出了Backend--Frontend转换器，这是一种用于生成基于组件的模型TypeScript实现的架构。该转换器将组件、连接、别名和公式树映射到模型特定的TypeScript代码。可重用的运行时库提供数值积分、数据访问和状态管理。我们通过四个轨道场景和记录的交易策略比较来评估存储的生成实现。轨道计算在浏览器中执行，并通过交叉事件和时间戳与C#结果配对；交易输出按日期对齐。分析调度器测试和故意扰动的输出评估验证过程。每个轨道场景产生91对具有相同时间戳的事件。位置和速度差异保持在$(10^{-6}\)~km$和$(10^{-9}\)~km/s$以下。所有20个分析调度器检查均通过，比较器检测到每种规定的三种状态和时间扰动。交易比较包含501对齐的每日记录，具有匹配的指标值、位置和订单事件。评估的实现跨C#/TypeScript边界保留了比较输出。特定组件的生成和可重用的执行库为支持的.NET计算模型到TypeScript应用程序提供了实用途径。

articles.title: Vocal-Tract Acoustics, Aerodynamics, and Overlap-and-Add Synthesis in DYNARTmo
articles.abstract: This paper presents the acoustic and aerodynamic extension of DYNARTmo, a dynamic articulatory model for visualizing and synthesizing speech production. Gestural control trajectories determine vocal-tract geometry, which is converted into an acoustic tube with nasal branching and effective lateral passages. A lumped aerodynamic network relates prescribed glottal motion and pulmonary pressure to airflow and supraglottal pressure storage. Phonatory excitation, oral friction, and glottal aspiration are synthesized as separate contributions. Frame-specific acoustic responses are combined by overlap-and-add, preserving response tails beyond individual control frames. Three German words, ``Tasse'', ``Muse'', and ``Lade'', illustrate the coordination of articulation, pressure, flow, and acoustic sources across vowels, nasals, laterals, fricatives, and plosives. The implementation has been optimized by the author primarily for sound recognizability; independent perceptual evaluation remains outstanding, and fricative-noise naturalness requires further refinement. The model provides an inspectable, articulatorily controlled production plant for future neural simulations of babbling, imitation, and early word acquisition. Further work will improve acoustic realism, reduce empirical source corrections, and extend the sensory information available to developmental learning models.
articles.comment: 6 figures; ancillary Python reference implementation and word-transcription guide. No audio recordings or saved timelines
articles.titleCn: 声道声学、空气动力学以及DYNART中的重叠相加合成
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了DYNARTmo的声学和空气动力学扩展，DYNARTmo是一个用于可视化和合成语音生产的动态发音模型。手势控制轨迹决定了声道几何形状，这被转换为具有鼻分支和有效侧向通道的声学管道。集总空气动力学网络将规定的声门运动和肺压与空气流量和声门上压力存储相关联。发声激励、口腔摩擦和声门吸吮被合成作为单独的贡献。特定帧的声学响应通过重叠相加组合，保留了单个控制帧之外的响应尾部。三个德语单词“Tasse”、“Muse”和“Lade”说明了元音、鼻音、侧向音、擦音和爆破音之间发音、压力、流量和声学源的协调。作者主要为了声音的可识别性优化了该模型的实现；独立的感知评估仍然不足，擦音-噪声的自然度需要进一步改进。该模型为未来咿呀学语、模仿和早期词汇习得的神经模拟提供了一个可检查的、发音控制的语音生成系统。未来的工作将提高声学真实性，减少经验性源校正，并扩展可供发展学习模型使用的感官信息。

articles.title: Modeling Discourse Profiles in Climate Misinformation Discourse
articles.abstract: Prior work on climate misinformation detection typically classifies individual comments or claims using text alone. This framing overlooks a key property of online climate discourse: misinformation is often produced, reinforced, and sustained through recurring rhetorical patterns that reappear across comments and threads. Using a large-scale TikTok climate discourse dataset, we construct discourse profiles by clustering climate-related comments into recurring rhetorical patterns. We then incorporate these profiles into fine-grained climate misinformation classifiers using a late-fusion architecture. Under video-disjoint evaluation across three training seeds, discourse-profile-aware models significantly improve macro-F1 over text-only baselines for bag-of-words, TF-IDF, and MPNet representations. RoBERTa-large exhibits a positive mean improvement but substantially greater variability, and the difference is not statistically significant. Beyond classification, our results show discourse profiles shape misinformation reception and propagation. Discourse-profile-conditioned language model agents exhibit misinformation acceptance patterns aligned with profile-level misinformation prevalence in ClimateDisc, and the relationship between misinformation prevalence and engagement persistence differs across dominant discourse profiles.
articles.titleCn: 气候虚假信息话语中的话语特征建模
articles.abstractCn: 以往关于气候虚假信息检测的研究通常仅通过文本对单个评论或声明进行分类。这种框架忽略了网络气候讨论的一个关键特性：虚假信息往往通过反复出现的修辞模式在评论和讨论串中被产生、强化和维持。我们利用大规模的TikTok气候讨论数据集，通过将气候相关评论聚类为反复出现的修辞模式来构建讨论特征。然后，我们使用晚期融合架构将这些特征整合到细粒度的气候虚假信息分类器中。在跨三个训练种子的视频不连续评估下，讨论特征感知模型在词袋模型、TF-IDF和MPNet表示上，宏观F1分数均显著优于纯文本基线模型。RoBERTa-large表现出积极的平均改进，但变异性显著更大，且差异在统计上不显著。除了分类，我们的结果表明讨论特征会塑造虚假信息的接收和传播。受讨论特征条件约束的语言模型代理表现出与ClimateDisc中特征级别虚假信息盛行度一致的虚假信息接受模式，且虚假信息盛行度与参与持久度之间的关系在不同主导讨论特征中存在差异。

articles.title: Write Once, Check Many: Reusable Ledgers for Post-Hoc Policy Compliance Auditing of Agent Trajectories
articles.abstract: Auditing LLM agents against policies is critical to ensure safety but requires rereading long trajectories once per policy. Can we instead record each trajectory once and reuse that record for policies not known in advance? We propose write once, check many, a framework in which a writer model converts each agent trajectory into a policy-independent ledger of the agent's actions and outcomes. A reader then checks each new policy against the ledger alone, without access to the original trajectory. On 900 trajectories from SHADE-Arena, $τ$-bench, and $τ^2$-bench, we show that a 12B reader of narrative ledgers can either match or in fact achieve higher AUC than the same 12B model reading full trajectories. On SHADE-Arena policies that combine several facts, our approach outperforms a 31B model reading the trajectory (.777 vs. .713 AUC). When checking eight SHADE-Arena policies separately, ledgers use about $5\times$ fewer tokens, including the cost of writing them. A deeper analysis shows that rule-based extraction performs better on some single-action policies, and ledgers can miss evidence in long tool outputs and message contents. Our results suggest that reusable, policy-independent records can make retrospective agent auditing more efficient and effective, and highlight important considerations in ledger design.
articles.titleCn: 一次编写，多次检查：用于事后政策合规性审计的智能体轨迹可重用账本
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型代理的政策审计对于确保安全至关重要，但需要针对每个政策重新阅读长轨迹。我们能否改为记录每个轨迹一次，并重复使用该记录来处理未知的政策？我们提出了“一次写入，多次检查”的框架，其中写入模型将每个代理轨迹转换为与政策无关的代理行为和结果的账本。然后，读取器仅根据账本检查每个新政策，而无需访问原始轨迹。在来自SHADE-Arena、$τ$-bench和$τ^2$-bench的900个轨迹上，我们证明了一个12B的叙事账本读取器可以与相同的12B模型读取完整轨迹相匹配，甚至可以实现更高的AUC。在SHADE-Arena结合多个事实的政策上，我们的方法优于一个31B模型读取轨迹（AUC为0.777，对比0.713）。当分别检查SHADE-Arena的八项政策时，账本使用的token数量减少了约5倍，包括写入它们的成本。更深入的分析表明，基于规则的提取在某些单行动政策上表现更好，而账本可能会遗漏长工具输出和消息内容中的证据。我们的结果表明，可重复使用、与政策无关的记录可以使回顾性代理审计更加高效和有效，并突出了账本设计中的重要考虑因素。

articles.title: Beyond Recall Saturation: Scaling Hard-Negative Reranker Training for Industrial Legal Retrieval
articles.abstract: Industrial retrieval systems often improve quality by enlarging embedding candidate pools or adopting complex training pipelines. We show that, under a sufficiently large but practical candidate pool, embedding recall exhibits diminishing returns, motivating a closer examination of reranker quality. On Chinese legal retrieval benchmarks, embedding top-300 reaches a high-recall operating region, while relevant evidence may still be ranked below the output cutoff. We compare hard-negative strategies for reranker training, including embedding-mined, self-mined, and dynamic-negative variants, under aligned retrieval protocols that evaluate reranking after candidate retrieval. Among the evaluated staged configurations, an embedding-to-self-mined pipeline provides a favorable trade-off; additional dynamic stages do not improve all held-out metrics. The selected pipeline scales from a 0.6B to a 4B reranker. Relative to the native 4B reranker, the trained 4B Stage2 model improves reported metrics on the STARD and CSAID benchmarks and on an internal development set, and is preferred in 72.4\% of non-tied comparisons on 410 de-identified, reconstructed internal operational-query inputs in a latency-sensitive offline preference evaluation. These results support evaluating the retrieval and reranking stages separately when selecting an optimization target for industrial retrieval systems.
articles.titleCn: 超越召回饱和：工业法律检索中硬负样本重新排序训练的规模化
articles.abstractCn: 工业检索系统通常通过扩大嵌入候选池或采用复杂的训练流程来提升质量。我们证明，在足够大但实用的候选池下，嵌入召回率表现出边际效益递减，这促使我们更深入地研究重排序器的质量。在中国法律检索基准测试中，嵌入排名前300的结果能达到高召回率操作区域，但相关证据可能仍被排在输出截止点以下。我们在对齐检索协议下，比较了用于重排序器训练的多种硬负样本策略，包括嵌入挖掘、自挖掘和动态负样本变体。在评估的阶段性配置中，嵌入到自挖掘的流程提供了良好的权衡；额外的动态阶段并未提升所有保留指标的得分。选定的流程可从0.6B扩展到4B重排序器。与原生4B重排序器相比，训练的4B Stage2模型在STARD和CSAID基准测试以及内部开发集上提升了报告指标，并在延迟敏感的离线偏好评估中，在410个去标识化、重建的内部操作查询输入中，72.4%的非平局比较中更受青睐。这些结果支持在为工业检索系统选择优化目标时，分别评估检索和重排序阶段。

articles.title: Ben-Misandry: A Bengali Dataset and Late-Fusion Transformer Framework for Detecting Anti-Male Gender Hate
articles.abstract: Gender based hate speech research in Bengali has focused almost exclusively on misogyny, leaving anti male hate, or misandry, entirely unstudied for this language and creating a systematic blind spot in moderation systems trained to catch attacks on women but not on men. We introduce Ben-Misandry, the first Bengali misandry detection dataset: 5,000 comments across six taxonomy classes, including a novel category for mocking male emotional vulnerability with no direct analogue in existing misogyny taxonomies. The corpus is taxonomy-controlled synthetic data generated with GPT-4.1, spot-checked by four human reviewers on a 500-comment sample who confirmed the large majority of assigned labels; a full inter-annotator- agreement study is left to future work. We benchmark it with a classical pipeline (seven classifiers over four text representations) and a transformer pipeline (BanglaBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and two fusion strategies). The best classical model, a linear SVM over character-level TF-IDF, reaches 91.8% accuracy; a late fusion ensemble averaging BanglaBERT and XLM-RoBERTa softmax outputs reaches 96.6% accuracy and macro ROC-AUC above 99%, nominally ahead of every single model and early fusion, though we have not run significance testing to confirm these margins are meaningful. We relate this to classifier combination theory, under which averaging encoders with decorrelated errors is expected to reduce variance, and corroborate the decision boundary with Shapley explanations that recover the same class- discriminative vocabulary found in our exploratory analysis, while noting this cannot rule out the model partly keying on synthetic-generation artifacts. Our results indicate misandry detection in Bengali is feasible and measurable on this synthetic corpus, offered as an initial public resource pending validation on real-world data.
articles.titleCn: 反男性性别仇恨：一个孟加拉语数据集和晚期融合Transformer框架
articles.abstractCn: 孟加拉语中基于性别的仇恨言论研究几乎完全集中在厌女症上，而针对男性的仇恨言论，即厌男症，则在这一语言中完全未被研究，从而在训练用于检测针对女性攻击但忽略男性攻击的审核系统中造成了系统性的盲点。我们介绍了Ben-Misandry，首个孟加拉语厌男症检测数据集：包含5000条评论，分为六个分类类别，其中包括一个现有厌女症分类体系中没有直接对应的新类别，用于嘲讽男性的情感脆弱性。该语料库是经过分类控制的合成数据，使用GPT-4.1生成，并由四位人类评审员对500条评论样本进行抽查，他们确认了绝大多数分配的标签；完整的人工标注者间一致性研究留待未来工作。我们使用经典流程（七个分类器应用于四种文本表示）和Transformer流程（BanglaBERT、XLM-RoBERTa和两种融合策略）对其进行基准测试。最佳经典模型，即基于字符级TF-IDF的线性SVM，准确率达到91.8%；晚期融合集成平均BanglaBERT和XLM-RoBERTa的softmax输出，准确率达到96.6%，宏观ROC-AUC超过99%，名义上领先于所有单个模型和早期融合，尽管我们尚未进行显著性检验以确认这些差距是否有意义。我们将其与分类器组合理论联系起来，该理论认为，平均具有不相关误差的编码器可以减少方差，并通过Shapley解释验证决策边界，这些解释恢复了我们在探索性分析中发现的相同类别区分性词汇，同时指出这并不能排除模型部分依赖于合成生成过程中的伪影。我们的结果表明，在孟加拉语中检测厌男症是可行的，并且在合成语料库上可以进行测量，该语料库作为初步公共资源提供，有待在真实世界数据上进行验证。

articles.title: Pluralistic Alignment in Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
articles.abstract: Pluralistic alignment aims to represent meaningful variation in human preferences rather than collapse heterogeneous judgments into a single target. Yet existing work often mixes three distinct questions: what pluralistic behavior a model should exhibit, whose preferences define the reference, and what evidence is sufficient to demonstrate success. We organize the literature around a two-layer taxonomy. Layer 1 distinguishes representing a range of human-supported viewpoints (Overton Pluralism), adapting faithfully to a specified perspective or preference condition (Steerable Pluralism), and matching the response distribution observed in a target population (Distributional Pluralism). Layer 2 distinguishes aggregate populations, countries and regions, and subgroups as human references. Preference representation, implementation mechanism, modality, and evidence quality are treated as cross-cutting design choices rather than additional forms of pluralism. We synthesize a protocol-bounded corpus of 70 works on pluralistic alignment and neighboring areas, using the objective-by-human-reference matrix to map existing approaches and identify underexplored combinations. The coded literature concentrates on Steerable Pluralism and Distributional Pluralism, while eligible Overton Pluralism work appears only at the aggregate-population level under our stated protocol. We then connect each objective to the evidence needed to support it, including perspective validity, conditional fidelity, distributional fidelity, support preservation, and uncertainty in subgroup estimates. Together, the taxonomy and evaluation framework clarify what current methods establish, where their claims exceed their evidence, and how future systems can represent disagreement without mistaking variation for faithful representation.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中的多元对齐：目标、人类参考和偏好表示
