articles.abstractCn: 多元对齐旨在体现人类偏好的有意义差异，而非将异质判断归并为单一目标。然而现有工作常将三个不同问题混淆：模型应展现何种多元行为、谁的偏好定义参照标准，以及何种证据足以证明成功。我们围绕双层分类法组织文献。第一层区分体现人类支持的多重视角（奥尔顿多元主义）、忠实适应指定视角或偏好条件（可操控多元主义）以及匹配目标群体观察到的响应分布（分布多元主义）。第二层区分总体人群、国家和地区以及亚群体作为人类参照。偏好表示、实现机制、模态和证据质量被视为跨领域设计选择，而非多元主义的额外形式。我们综合了70篇关于多元对齐及相关领域的协议约束语料，利用目标-人类参照矩阵映射现有方法并识别未充分探索的组合。编码文献集中于可操控多元主义和分布多元主义，而符合规定的奥尔顿多元主义工作仅在我们设定的协议下出现在总体人群层面。随后我们将每个目标与支持其所需的证据相连接，包括视角有效性、条件忠实度、分布忠实度、支持保留和亚群体估计的不确定性。综合来看，分类法和评估框架厘清了当前方法已建立的内容、其主张超出证据的范围，以及未来系统如何在不将差异误认为忠实表示的情况下体现分歧。

articles.title: Which Long Documents Matter? A Controlled Study of Data Selection for Context Extension
articles.abstract: Natural long documents are widely used for context extension, but which selection pipelines are effective remains unclear. We conduct a controlled comparison on Qwen2.5-3B at 128K under matched 6B-token continued-training budgets. Random sampling of natural long documents (random-long) outperforms repacking at longer evaluation lengths. Within the same candidate pool, selecting documents with high LongPPL key-token density yields further gains, unlike the evaluated generic-quality and LLM-judge selectors. We introduce truncLongPPL to reduce scoring cost by computing key-token density over a truncated prefix. At 128K, scoring the first half of the reference span yields downstream performance close to full-span scoring with a measured $2.28\times$ end-to-end scoring speedup. Across three training seeds, truncLongPPL achieves the highest mean scores among evaluated pipelines, exceeding random-long by 4.54 points on validation HELMET and 3.28 on held-out RULER, with gains most consistent in retrieval. At a 256K target context, it gains 2.82 average RULER points over random-long on Qwen2.5-3B. In short/long mixed training across Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen3-8B, and OLMo~3-7B, it gains 1.47--7.31 average RULER points over random-long mixing, with seven-task short-context averages within 0.23 points of the corresponding baselines. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Qwen3-8B and OLMo~3-7B models trained with selected long documents outperform their random-long counterparts by 1.13--1.67 points on LongBench v2 and 0.62--1.44 points on MRCR.
articles.titleCn: 哪些长文档是重要的？一项关于上下文扩展数据选择的控制研究
articles.abstractCn: 自然长文档被广泛用于上下文扩展，但哪些选择流程是有效的尚不明确。我们在128K的Qwen2.5-3B模型上，在匹配的6B-token持续训练预算下进行了受控比较。随机选择自然长文档（random-long）在较长的评估长度上表现优于重新打包。在相同的候选池中，选择具有高LongPPL关键token密度的文档能进一步提升性能，这与评估中的通用质量选择器和LLM判断选择器不同。我们引入了truncLongPPL来通过计算截断前缀的关键token密度来降低评分成本。在128K时，评分参考跨度的一半即可获得接近完整跨度评分的下游性能，且端到端评分速度提升2.28倍。在三个训练种子中，truncLongPPL在评估流程中实现了最高的平均分数，在验证HELMET上超过random-long 4.54分，在保留RULER上超过3.28分，且在检索任务中收益最为稳定。在256K的目标上下文中，Qwen2.5-3B模型上truncLongPPL比random-long平均多2.82分RULER。简而言之，在Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen3-8B和OLMo~3-7B的短/长混合训练中，truncLongPPL比random-long混合平均多1.47--7.31分RULER，七个任务的短上下文平均分与对应基线相差0.23分以内。在监督微调（SFT）后，使用选择长文档训练的Qwen3-8B和OLMo~3-7B模型在LongBench v2上比random-long对应模型多1.13--1.67分，在MRCR上多0.62--1.44分。

articles.title: When Opposite Premises Translate Identically: A Source-Conditioned Diagnostic for Multilingual Commonsense Items
articles.abstract: Multilingual reasoning comparisons depend on translated premises preserving the relations in their English sources. Automatic translation scores can rank source-target pairs, but an acceptance decision alone cannot certify a counterfactual benchmark field. We test a source-contrast diagnostic for ACCORD premises: reverse the English polarity, translate both arms independently, count identical target outputs, and score each arm against its own source. Across 71 matched question identities at two containing-item depths, five target languages, and three translation checkpoints, Swahili has 63, 113, and 67 exact collisions among 710 pairs per checkpoint. At a human-reference-calibrated threshold, round-trip NLI passes both arms of 3 of the 113 NLLB-3.3B collisions, while LaBSE passes 78. Each collision proves at least one unfaithful translation, but does not identify its arm. These controlled measurements do not establish screening accuracy on spontaneous translation errors or a language-by-hop reasoning effect; the study has no native equivalence labels or answer-model evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 当相反前提翻译完全一致时：一种基于源语言的常识判断方法
articles.abstractCn: 多语言推理比较依赖于翻译前提保留其英语来源中的关系。自动翻译评分可以排序源-目标对，但仅靠接受决策无法认证反事实基准领域。我们测试了ACCORD前提的源对比诊断方法：反转英语极性，独立翻译两臂，统计相同的目标输出，并针对每臂与其自身源进行评分。在包含项深度为两层的71个匹配问题身份、五种目标语言和三个翻译检查点中，斯瓦希里语在每个检查点710对中分别有63、113和67个完全匹配。在人类参考校准的阈值下，往返自然语言推理通过113个NLLB-3.3B碰撞中的3对的两个臂，而LaBSE通过78对。每次碰撞都证明至少存在一次不忠实翻译，但无法识别其臂。这些受控测量并未建立对自发翻译错误的筛选精度或语言-跳转推理效应；该研究没有原生等价标签或答案模型评估。

articles.title: Toward a Universal Local Speech Feature Extractor Through Distillation
articles.abstract: Self-supervised speech models commonly consist of a set of convolutional neural network (CNN) layers used as a local feature extractor, followed by transformer layers. The CNN layers are computationally demanding, and are also similar across models and resemble the much simpler mel spectral features. We hypothesize that the CNN layers can be replaced by a simple, universal model. To test this hypothesis, we learn a two-layer feature extractor via distillation from one or more teacher models (HuBERT, data2vec, and WavLM). Experiments on SUPERB(-SG) benchmark tasks show that our model largely retains the performance of the teacher models and can also be used in an unseen model (wav2vec 2.0). Our feature extractor requires only 3% of the MACs of the CNNs, resulting in a $>$20% overall inference runtime reduction.
articles.titleCn: 通过蒸馏构建通用本地语音特征提取器
articles.abstractCn: 自监督语音模型通常由一组用作局部特征提取器的卷积神经网络（CNN）层，随后接上Transformer层组成。CNN层计算量大，且模型间的CNN层相似，并类似于更简单的梅尔谱特征。我们假设CNN层可以被一个简单、通用的模型替代。为验证这一假设，我们通过从一个或多个教师模型（HuBERT、data2vec和WavLM）进行蒸馏来学习一个两层特征提取器。在SUPERB(-SG)基准任务上的实验表明，我们的模型在很大程度上保留了教师模型的表现，并且也可以用于未见过的新模型（wav2vec 2.0）。我们的特征提取器仅需CNN的3%的MAC，从而将整体推理运行时间减少了20%以上。

articles.title: Ask Less, Ask Better: Allocating User Attention in Proactive LLM Agents with Interruption Budgets
articles.abstract: LLM agents can ask clarifying questions to complete tasks, but answering each question demands users' time and effort. Existing evaluations typically measure this burden by counting questions, treating necessary and avoidable questions equally. We propose an evaluation protocol that distinguishes how often agents ask from how well they ask. An interruption budget limits the number of questions, while a user-attention cost charges extra for questions that are hard to read or not worth asking, as rated by a human-validated LLM judge. Beyond question counts, this cost captures perceived effort: on conversation pairs with the same number of questions, human annotators agreed with the cost on which conversation required more effort 75% of the time. Across eight LLMs and four customer-service domains, limiting agents to one to three questions reduces user-attention cost by 36-73% while keeping 86-94% of the task reward they earn with unlimited questions. At the same budget, reviewing each question against the memory of users' earlier answers cuts attention cost by another 13% with little reward loss and yields more valuable questions. Models also differ sharply in how well they ask: at the same user-attention cost, the most efficient models gain more than twice as much reward from their questions as the others. These results show that asking less and asking better are distinct goals, and that evaluations of proactive agents should measure both.
articles.titleCn: 少问，多问精：具有中断预算的主动LLM代理中的用户注意力分配
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理可以通过提问澄清问题来完成任务，但回答每个问题都需要用户花费时间和精力。现有的评估通常通过计算问题数量来衡量这种负担，将必要问题和可避免问题同等对待。我们提出了一种评估协议，区分代理提问的频率和提问的质量。中断预算限制了问题的数量，而用户注意力成本则额外收取难以阅读或不值得提问的问题费用，这些问题的评分由经过人工验证的LLM裁判员提供。除了问题数量之外，这种成本还捕捉了感知到的努力：在问题数量相同的不同对话对中，人类标注员75%的时间内同意哪个对话需要更多努力。在八个LLM和四个客户服务领域中，将代理限制在1到3个问题内，可以将用户注意力成本降低36-73%，同时保持86-94%的任务奖励，这些奖励是在无限制提问的情况下获得的。在相同的预算下，根据用户先前回答的记忆审查每个问题，可以将注意力成本降低13%，奖励损失很小，并且产生更有价值的问题。模型在提问质量上也有显著差异：在相同的用户注意力成本下，最高效的模型从其问题中获得的奖励是其他模型的超过两倍。这些结果表明，提问更少和提问更好是不同的目标，主动代理的评估应该衡量这两个方面。

articles.title: Long Listening Thoughts: Eliciting Open Auditory Reasoning with Deliberative Perception and Cognitive Refinement
articles.abstract: We introduce Long Listening Thoughts (LLT), a framework for constructing post-training datasets that improves audio reasoning by pairing deliberate perceptual grounding with explicit cognitive behaviors. On audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks, large audio-language models (LALMs) are limited primarily by perceptual errors, yet existing post-training datasets rely on audio descriptions of limited diversity. Through a four-stage pipeline, LLT (1) builds multi-aspect dense audio descriptions spanning semantic, acoustic, and temporal information, (2) generates more challenging questions, (3) synthesizes incorrect reasoning traces, and (4) extends short reasoning traces into long ones via a thought-continuation strategy that elicits cognitive behaviors such as verification and backtracking. Using LLT, we synthesize 1.6M reasoning traces and train Qwen2.5-Omni-7B with a two-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by direct preference optimization (DPO). This improves accuracy on MMAU Test-mini (71.5 to 78.2), MMAR (56.7 to 63.7), and MMSU (60.6 to 66.0).
articles.comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://jaeyeonkim99.github.io/llt
articles.titleCn: 深度聆听之思：通过审慎感知与认知精炼激发开放性听觉推理
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了长听思框架（LLT），这是一个用于构建训练后数据集的框架，通过将有意感知基础与明确的认知行为相结合，提升了音频推理能力。在音频理解和推理基准测试中，大型音频语言模型（LALMs）主要受限于感知错误，而现有的训练后数据集依赖于多样性有限的音频描述。通过四阶段流程，LLT（1）构建涵盖语义、声学和时序信息的多方面密集音频描述；（2）生成更具挑战性的问题；（3）合成错误的推理轨迹；（4）通过引发验证和回溯等认知行为的思维延续策略，将短推理轨迹扩展为长轨迹。使用LLT，我们合成了160万条推理轨迹，并采用监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）的两阶段流程训练Qwen2.5-Omni-7B。这提升了MMAU Test-mini（71.5提升至78.2）、MMAR（56.7提升至63.7）和MMSU（60.6提升至66.0）的准确率。

articles.title: Defending Against Dormant Poisoning Attacks Across Language and Multimodal Agents
articles.abstract: Recent work shows that attackers can implant dormant malicious behaviors that remain hidden at release but emerge after benign fine-tuning. As foundation models are used as agents, whether dormant poisoning extends to harmful agent actions and multimodal settings remains unclear. We show two agentic risks: (1) harmful behaviors activated by benign fine-tuning can extend to unseen actions; (2) multiple harmful behaviors can coexist and be jointly activated by benign downstream fine-tuning. Existing defenses often rely on external safe responses, which are hard to obtain for agent actions, or a trusted clean reference model. We exploit a key property of dormant poisoning: the attacker must preserve safe behavior at release to conceal poisoning, and this behavior can serve as a safety reference. Leveraging this property, we automatically construct a Safety Buffer pairing harmful inputs with the released model's responses and benign versions generated by the same model to remove harmful intent. The Safety Buffer can replace external safe responses in existing defenses, but these defenses do not distinguish updates that weaken safety from those that preserve it, often increasing over-refusal or reducing utility. To address this limitation, we introduce LookAhead Defense, which previews benign fine-tuning updates using the Safety Buffer and penalizes only updates predicted to weaken safe behavior on harmful inputs or increase the likelihood of refusals on benign versions in the Safety Buffer. Across language models, language agents, and multimodal agents, LookAhead Defense reduces harmful behavior in agents from up to 93.9% to at most 14.2% and harmful responses in language models from up to 92.5% to at most 2.0% versus vanilla fine-tuning, while maintaining competitive utility and low over-refusal. It remains effective against other poisoning methods.
articles.titleCn: 防御跨语言和多模态代理的休眠中毒攻击
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究表明，攻击者可以植入潜伏的恶意行为，这些行为在发布时保持隐藏，但在良性微调后显现。随着基础模型被用作代理，潜伏性中毒是否延伸至有害代理行为和多模态环境仍不明确。我们展示了两种代理风险：(1) 被良性微调激活的有害行为可以扩展至未见过的行为；(2) 多种有害行为可以共存，并由良性下游微调共同激活。现有防御通常依赖于外部安全响应，但获取代理行为的安全响应非常困难，或者依赖可信的干净参考模型。我们利用了潜伏性中毒的一个关键特性：攻击者必须在发布时保持安全行为以隐藏中毒，该行为可以作为安全参考。利用这一特性，我们自动构建了一个安全缓冲区，将有害输入与发布模型的行为以及由同一模型生成的良性版本配对，以消除有害意图。安全缓冲区可以替代现有防御中的外部安全响应，但这些防御无法区分削弱安全性的更新与保持安全性的更新，通常导致过度拒绝或降低效用。为解决这一局限性，我们引入了LookAhead防御，该防御使用安全缓冲区预览良性微调更新，并仅惩罚那些预测会在有害输入上削弱安全行为或在安全缓冲区中的良性版本上增加拒绝可能性的更新。在语言模型、语言代理和多模态代理中，LookAhead防御将代理的有害行为从高达93.9%降低至最多14.2%，将语言模型的有害响应从高达92.5%降低至最多2.0%，同时保持竞争性效用和低过度拒绝。它对其他中毒方法仍然有效。

articles.title: FlashMap: Flow Map Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose a block of tokens that the target model verifies in one parallel pass. Autoregressive drafters generate this block one token at a time, whereas block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate it in one pass, making drafting faster. However, these diffusion drafters predict each token independently, ignoring dependencies between tokens in the block. We introduce FlashMap, a continuous flow drafter that conditions a flow map language model on the target model's hidden states and generates the whole block in one forward pass while capturing inter-token dependencies. On Qwen3-8B, FlashMap is faster than a matched DFlash baseline on every benchmark, with 7% higher average speedup and up to 6.1x lossless acceleration.
articles.titleCn: FlashMap：流图推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码通过使用轻量级起草器来提议一个目标模型在单次并行遍历中验证的标记块，从而加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理。自回归起草器逐个生成这个标记块，而块扩散起草器（如DFlash）则一次性生成，使起草过程更快。然而，这些扩散起草器独立预测每个标记，忽略了块内标记之间的依赖关系。我们引入了FlashMap，这是一种连续流起草器，它基于目标模型的隐藏状态对流图语言模型进行条件化，并在单次前向遍历中生成整个标记块，同时捕捉标记间的依赖关系。在Qwen3-8B上，FlashMap在所有基准测试中都比匹配的DFlash基线更快，平均速度提升7%，最高无损加速达6.1倍。

articles.title: What Matters for NVFP4 Training? A Comparative Study of Low-Precision Pretraining Recipes
articles.abstract: Training large language models directly in 4-bit floating-point (FP) formats promises substantial improvements in throughput and energy efficiency. While some recipe design choices have been validated at scale, many promising approaches remain untested beyond small models and short token horizons, leaving open the question of which trends will hold. We present a systematic comparison of recent NVFP4 recipes at medium model scale, evaluating dense 8B and 30B-A3B MoE models trained for up to 1T tokens, with a focus on which ingredients are necessary for accuracy recovery. We propose a final recipe grounded in the principles behind established stable NVFP4 training at scale, incorporating state-of-the-art techniques such as unbiased gradient estimation with lower quantization error than stochastic rounding. To the best of our knowledge, this is the strongest FP4 training result demonstrated at this scale to date in loss gap to BF16. Through ablation studies, we find that: (i) each technique in the optimized recipe measurably improves loss trajectory, (ii) selective high-precision layers are necessary for recovering accuracy at scale, (iii) not all tensors in the backward pass benefit equally from de-biasing, leaving room to apply complementary error-reduction techniques to the remaining tensors.

articles.titleCn: 对NVFP4训练有何影响？一项关于低精度预训练配方比较的研究
articles.abstractCn: 直接以4位浮点数（FP）格式训练大型语言模型有望大幅提升吞吐量和能效。尽管一些配方设计选择已在规模化验证中通过，但许多有前景的方法仍未经小模型和短token时长的测试，留下了哪些趋势将得以延续的疑问。我们针对中等模型规模近期NVFP4配方进行了系统性比较，评估了用于训练高达1T token的密集8B和30B-A3B MoE模型，重点关注哪些成分对精度恢复是必要的。我们提出了一种基于已建立规模化稳定NVFP4训练原理的最终配方，融入了比随机舍入更低量化误差的无偏梯度估计等最先进技术。据我们所知，这是迄今为止在损失差距方面表现最强的FP4训练结果，与BF16相比达到了这一规模的最佳表现。通过消融研究，我们发现：(i) 优化配方中的每种技术都能显著改善损失轨迹，(ii) 选择性高精度层对于规模化精度恢复是必要的，(iii) 反向传播中的所有张量并非同等受益于去偏，为对剩余张量应用互补误差减少技术留下了空间。
